title: Sr. Lead Engineer, Integration & Automation
description:
Ready to be a Titan?

ServiceTitan's Finance Business Technology team is seeking a Sr Lead engineer , Integration & Automations to serve as the technical cornerstone of our integration and automation practice. This is a newly created role designed to elevate the maturity, reliability, and strategic impact of our integration estate across Finance, Revenue, Billing, People Technology, and Go-to-Market.

You will own the end-to-end technical vision for how our enterprise systems connect - spanning Workday Financials, Workday HCM, Workato, Salesforce, and a growing ecosystem of SaaS platforms. You will set and enforce engineering standards, lead architecture reviews, and serve as the primary technical partner to senior Finance, HR, and GTM stakeholders. You will also partner with and technically guide a cross-functional team of integration engineers and automation specialists across US and India-based pods.

This role is equal parts architect, technical lead, and team enabler. You will report directly to the Director of G&A Systems and play a central role in driving our AI and Automation goals.

What you'll do:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Define and maintain the integration architecture across Finance, Revenue, People Tech, and Go-to-Market domains, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards

  • Author and enforce integration design guidelines, coding standards, SLAs, and tiering frameworks based on business criticality - including patterns for error handling, idempotency, retry logic, and alerting

  • Lead architecture reviews for all net-new integrations and significant enhancements across the team's functional pods; own the final technical design decision on high-complexity builds

  • Evaluate and recommend tools, platforms, and integration patterns to support the evolving roadmap; assess build-vs-configure tradeoffs across iPaaS, native connectors, and custom API development

  • Conduct an audit of the current integration estate, identify technical debt and failure-prone patterns, and build and execute a prioritized hardening roadmap

  • Define and evolve the integration tier model - classifying integrations by business criticality and enforcing appropriate monitoring, SLA, and change management standards for each tier

Hands-On Engineering

  • Optimize and maintain complex integrations in Workday Studio (EIB, Core Connectors, Document Transformation, XSLT) and Workato, including net-new builds and major refactors of existing integrations

  • Develop reusable integration components, transformation templates, and shared libraries that reduce build time and enforce consistency across the team

  • Build and maintain API-based integrations connecting Workday, Salesforce, Snowflake, Avalara, Workato, and other platforms using REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, OAuth, and event-driven patterns

  • Own integration monitoring and alerting - instrumenting integrations with proactive health checks and ensuring failures surface before stakeholders notice them

  • Perform deep root cause analysis on critical integration failures; produce post-incident documentation and implement systemic fixes to prevent recurrence

Team Leadership & Development

  • Partner with the Manager to recruit, onboard, and develop integration talent across US and India-based pods

  • Run Integration & Automation grooming sessions - the biweekly stakeholder-facing forum where new integration requests are triaged, scoped, and sized before entering the cross-functional prioritization process

  • Serve as the L3 escalation point for integration incidents across all pods; ensure root cause analysis and preventive follow-up are completed for all critical failures

  • Foster a culture of documentation, runbook discipline, and knowledge sharing across onshore and offshore team members

Automation Program

  • Partner with the Manager to drive the AI and automation delivery pipeline, ensuring the backlog is continuously groomed and prioritized by impact

  • Identify and champion high-value automation opportunities surfaced through stakeholder grooming sessions and the automation initiative pipeline

  • Ensure all automation solutions are production-grade - monitored, documented, and resilient to upstream system changes

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the senior technical point of contact for Finance, People Tech, Revenue, Billing, and GTM stakeholders on integration-related matters

  • Translate complex integration and architecture concepts into clear, business-relevant communication for non-technical audiences

  • Participate in the Cross-Functional Prioritization Meeting, providing architectural input and capacity guidance to inform sprint planning

What you'll bring:

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise integration engineering, systems architecture, or a senior integration role

  • Proven hands-on experience with Workato or a comparable iPaaS platform (MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica); able to design, build, and maintain complex multi-step recipes and error-handling workflows independently

  • Hands-on expertise in Workday Studio - including EIB, Core Connectors, Document Transformation, and XSLT; ability to build and troubleshoot complex Studio integrations without vendor support

  • Strong command of integration architecture patterns: REST and SOAP API design, event-driven and pub/sub architecture, data transformation, idempotency, retry and dead-letter handling

  • Experience building API integrations against Salesforce (REST/Bulk API), Workday, Snowflake, or similar platforms; comfort reading and writing JSON, XML, and XSLT

  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams including offshore or distributed engineers; able to set the technical bar, conduct design reviews, and develop engineers below you

  • Experience building or maturing integration governance frameworks - tiering models, design standards, SLA frameworks, and monitoring and alerting practices

  • Ability to independently audit an integration estate, produce a prioritized technical debt roadmap, and execute against it

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; equally comfortable in a design review with engineers and a planning conversation with senior Finance or HR leaders

  • Experience working in a SaaS or high-growth technology company where agility and cross-functional collaboration are the norm

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience considered

NICE TO HAVE

  • Workday certification in Studio, Financials, or HCM

  • Experience with Salesforce integrations in a Revenue or Billing context, including CPQ or Salesforce Billing data flows

  • Familiarity with SQL and Snowflake for validating data flows, debugging transformation logic, and supporting Finance analytics use cases

  • Exposure to SOX-compliant integration environments and the documentation and audit requirements associated with them

  • Experience building out a greenfield integration practice or leading a team through a significant maturity uplift

  • Familiarity with Workday Orchestrate or event-driven automation patterns within the Workday platform

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.

title: Network Engineer, Level 3
description:
What You Will Do:

At Independent Software, as a Network Engineer Level 3, you will design, configure, deploy, and sustain network infrastructure supporting complex operational environments. You will work extensively with Cisco and Arista technologies while supporting network security, system upgrades, equipment fielding, and infrastructure modernization.

In addition to ongoing operational support, you will help design new systems and architect future environments as capabilities transition from legacy architectures toward containerized and potentially cloud-based solutions. This position includes hands-on lab work, remote and in-person system support, occasional travel, and participation in on-call support.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, configure, deploy, and sustain Cisco and Arista network infrastructure
  • Support network design and architecture for new systems and environments
  • Configure and test new systems, upgrades, and network configurations in lab environments
  • Support the remote and in-person fielding of new network equipment and capabilities
  • Provide ongoing network support, including firewall and crypto equipment
  • Troubleshoot complex network, connectivity, and infrastructure issues
  • Support modernization from legacy systems toward containerized and potentially cloud-based environments
  • Support network upgrades, cutovers, and configuration changes
  • Track and resolve technical and operational issues using JIRA or similar ticketing systems
  • Maintain network documentation, diagrams, configurations, and technical records
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and customer teams to maintain operational continuity
  • Participate in on-call operational support and occasional OCONUS travel as required

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Significant Cisco and Arista configuration and sustainment experience
  • Strong Network Engineering experience supporting complex operational environments
  • Experience with network design, routing, switching, and troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting firewalls, crypto equipment, and other network security technologies
  • Experience configuring, testing, upgrading, and troubleshooting network systems
  • Ability to work effectively in both lab and operational environments
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills
  • Ability to travel occasionally, including OCONUS, and participate in on-call operational support once trained

Desired Skills
  • Call Manager experience
  • Cisco ASA Firewall experience
  • Experience with network design and architecture
  • Experience automating repetitive tasks, inventory collection, or compliance activities
  • Experience with cloud, hyperconverged infrastructure, and containerized environments
  • Familiarity with LatteArt and supporting STE/STN requirements and SSP compliance

Education and Experience:

Candidates must meet one of the following:
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Assurance, Information Security Systems Engineering, or a related discipline from an accredited college or university plus ten (10) years of relevant professional Network Engineering experience; OR
  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering Science, Engineering Management, or a related discipline from an accredited college or university plus twelve (12) years of relevant professional Network Engineering experience; OR
  • Sixteen (16) years of relevant professional Network Engineering experience in lieu of a degree, along with an industry-recognized certification such as Arista Configuration Essentials, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or an applicable Juniper certification.

Certifications:

DoD Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level III baseline certification required in accordance with DoD 8570.01-M

Clearance Requirement:
  • Must possess an active TS SCI with appropriate Polygraph to be considered for this role


Why Choose Independent Software:

At Independent Software, our people are the mission. We’ve built a company around collaboration, integrity, and innovation and we make sure our team has the tools and support to grow, succeed, and thrive.

When you join us, you will:
  • Support critical national security missions that matter
  • Be part of a close-knit, employee-first culture where your voice is heard
  • Expand your skills through ongoing training, mentorship, and career development
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, generous benefits, and work-life balance


Ready to take the next step in your career? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Apply today.

description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

Objetivo principal del puesto:

Facilitar el incremento del uso y adopción de las terapias facilitadas por nuestra tecnología dentro de las instituciones de salud.

Garantizar la adopción, el uso adecuado y la continuidad de terapias altamente especializadas habilitadas por la tecnología de la compañía, mediante educación clínica personalizada y soporte clínico‑técnico a profesionales de la salud en entornos de alta complejidad. El puesto requiere un sólido conocimiento clínico y científico para diseñar y ejecutar intervenciones educativas adaptadas a las necesidades del médico, del paciente y del contexto institucional, asegurando una implementación correcta de la terapia y promoviendo la adherencia a protocolos y mejores prácticas.

Principales Actividades y Responsabilidades:

Facilitar la adopción y el uso correcto de las terapias del portafolio asignado dentro de las instituciones de salud, mediante capacitación clínica, acompañamiento técnico y soporte directo a los profesionales de la salud.

Brindar orientación clínica y científica basada en evidencia y experiencia en la terapia, apoyando a las instituciones en la evaluación clínica de soluciones terapéuticas, sin intervenir en decisiones comerciales o de adquisición.

  • Capacitar a médicos (Nefrólogos, Intensivistas, Hematólogos, Infectólogos, Reumatólogos, Cardiólogos y Neumólogos), enfermería, técnicos y personal clínico mediante entrenamientos iniciales, reentrenamientos y programas educativos adaptados a las necesidades de cada institución y especialidad.

  • Identificar oportunidades clínicas que permitan mejorar el desempeño de la terapia, optimizar indicadores, prevenir riesgos y fortalecer la continuidad terapéutica y la adecuada permanencia de los pacientes en tratamiento.

  • Brindar soporte consultivo durante el proceso de prescripción, resolviendo dudas técnicas y clínicas, y apoyando la adecuada selección y continuidad de la terapia asignada, mediante la ejecución de programas de educación de terapias a la medida, alineados a las necesidades del especialista y del entorno clínico.

  • Establecer y mantener relaciones estrechas con HCP’s y equipos multidisciplinarios, promoviendo la comunicación efectiva y el trabajo colaborativo para garantizar la continuidad del tratamiento.

  • Intervenir en planes preventivos y de seguimiento clínico, detectando usuarios con riesgo asociado al manejo de la terapia y apoyando en acciones para mejorar los resultados clínicos.

  • Aportar información relevante sobre necesidades clínicas, patrones de uso y oportunidades, para fortalecer la estrategia institucional y el desarrollo integral del portafolio.

  • Colaborar de manera interna en actividades relacionadas con compromisos contractuales, asegurando el cumplimiento adecuado de los acuerdos clínicos en los programas asignados.

  • Promover una cultura de ética y cumplimiento, asegurando que todas las actividades educativas y de soporte clínico se desarrollen conforme a las políticas, lineamientos regulatorios y el código de conducta de Vantive.

Powered by Enterprise Marketing Return (EMR), our differentiated approach to holistic media buying, planning, and measurement, EMRge is the first MarTech platform to measure businesses holistically. We're all about raising the bar every day, and it shows. Our work has been recognized by organizations like Digiday, Google, Inc. 5000, USA Today, and Search Engine Land.

About the Role:

Digital Marketing is a critical part of every consumer journey, but many companies only measure its impact on their digital outcomes. Our approach to digital media optimization at Ovative Group can’t be found anywhere else. We measure and optimize marketing campaigns at the enterprise level, both online and offline. Our clients are household names that span multiple industries, including retail, healthcare, education, CPG, and hospitality.

We are looking for a bold Account Director to join our team at a fast-growing company with the highest standards of talent, fun, and client success. In this role, you will be responsible for leading two to four major client accounts, focused on driving strategic business impact, creating a world-class client experience, and steering mid-to-long-term account growth. The ideal candidate will demonstrate phenomenal client relationship management, inspiring team leadership, strong critical thinking skills, as well as an understanding of the digital marketing industry.

This candidate must be self-directed, comfortable supporting multiple work streams, and be able to think critically to identify opportunities for further innovations and communicate effectively.

Responsibilities of an Account Director, Client Services:

    • Develop and lead cross-functional marketing strategies and roadmaps aligned with client priorities that drive results and grow the business on a one-to-three-year

    • Accountable for regular & timely messaging on overall health of accounts to key senior internal & external partners

    • Responsible for overall performance KPIs keeping a pulse against goals removing barriers to drive forward momentum.

    • Accountable Lead, drive, retain and grow the overall relationship and performance of two to four Ovative accounts

    • Effectively manage client relationships, establishing trust and credibility and serving as an expert on their business for digital media, measurement and the overall business model

    • Own the relationship strategy and create strong relationships with key decisions makers, beyond day to day contacts

  • Team Leadership and Employee Development

    • Actively coach account teams, account managers & future account directors to solve complex client problems

    • Support teams in structuring their workstreams, allocating team resources, providing role clarity and aligning subject matter expertise as needed

    • Foster a culture of open communication, and candid 360-degree feedback

    • Inspire account teams and direct reports to achieve their quarterly, annual, and long-term goals, helping to mitigate roadblocks along the way

    • Inform staffing strategy and help recruit, onboard and develop new Ovative team members and leaders

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience directly responsible for leading cross-functional business strategies through clear communication, structured problem solving skills, and project management ownership

  • Strong ability to solve analytical, conceptual and big picture problems using sound critical thinking techniques

  • Experience building, leading, and developing teams with diverse team members from a range of backgrounds

  • Possess a strong business acumen & deep understanding of how digital can drive an enterprise business forward

Preferred:

  • Previous experience operating hands-on digital marketing strategies and execution to drive business impact

  • Digital strategy consulting experience

  • Media planning and buying experience

  • Experience across both branding and direct response initiatives

Pay Transparency:

At Ovative, we offer a transparent view into three core components of your total compensation package: Base Salary, Annual Bonus, and Benefits. The salary range for this position below is inclusive of an annual bonus. Actual offers are made with consideration for relevant experience and anticipated impact. Additional benefits information is provided below.

For our Director positions, our compensation ranges from $170,000 to $228,000, which is inclusive of a 30% bonus.

Benefits of Working at Ovative Group:

We provide strong, competitive, holistic benefits that understand the importance of your life inside and out of work.

Culture:

Culture matters and we’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace for ten years running because of it. We demand trust and transparency from each other. We believe in doing the hard and complicated work others put off. We’re open in communication and floor plan. We’re flat – our interns sit next to VPs, our analysts work closely with senior leaders, and our CEO interacts with every single person daily. Compensation and Insurance:

We strive to hire and retain the best talent. Paying fair, competitive compensation, with a large bonus incentive, and phenomenal health insurance is an important part of this mix.

We’re rewarded fairly and when the company performs well, we all benefit.

Tangible amenities we enjoy:

Working at Ovative won’t be easy, but if you like getting your hands dirty, driving results, and being surrounded by the best talent, it’ll be the most rewarding job you’ll ever have. If you think you can make us better, we want to hear from you!

Summary of Job Duties:

The Clinical Pharmacy Specialist (CPS) for Ambulatory Care provides comprehensive pharmacotherapy support in the ambulatory care setting, serving as a consultative resource to providers on evidence-based therapeutic alternatives, medication optimization, and drug information. The Ambulatory CPS collaborates daily with the interdisciplinary care team to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care across a broad ambulatory population, including direct patient care services provided under approved collaborative practice agreements. Responsibilities include reviewing and interpreting medication orders, laboratory data, and complete medication profiles to ensure safe, effective, and appropriate drug therapy while identifying and mitigating potential drug interactions and medication-related problems. The Ambulatory CPS contributes to clinical protocol development and quality initiatives and serves as a preceptor for pharmacy students and residents. The Ambulatory CPS is expected to obtain credentialing as a Clinical Pharmacy Specialist through the UAMS Medical Board Credentialing Committee within six months of employment.


Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Graduate of an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy with a Doctor of Pharmacy or BS Pharmacy Degree

  • PGY1 residency training OR 3 years of applicable experience

  • Arkansas Pharmacist license or eligible for Arkansas licensure

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Completion of an ASHP-accredited PGY2 residency in Ambulatory Care or 5 years of experience working as a clinical pharmacy specialist in an Ambulatory Care setting

  • Board of Pharmacy Specialties Certification preferred and required within 3 years of hiring


Additional Information:

Responsibilities:

  • Leads assigned patient service lines, clinical areas, and therapeutic programs

  • Facilitates pharmaceutical care services, direct patient care programs, and medication utilization systems within assigned services and care areas to assure drug utilization activities are aligned with patient care needs, evidence-based best practices, and regulatory standards

  • Designs and implements stewardship activities and restriction/surveillance programs

  • Tracks and evaluates assigned pharmacy programs for operational, quality, and financial efficiency and routinely benchmarks against local and national best practices

  • Actively identifies practice-related issues that require evaluation and facilitates clinical research projects, quality improvement initiatives, or healthcare provider education as needed to advance practice

  • Assures pharmacy is an integral part of the health-care delivery system and facilitates enhancement and expansion of pharmacy services/programs

  • Delivers direct patient care and clinical practice, including decentralized and service-based programs

  • Maintains proficiency in decentralized pharmacy services and clinical pharmacy programs

  • Works as an active member of a multidisciplinary team and collaborates with healthcare providers within decentralized patient care areas to provide patient-centered care

  • Identifies high-risk patients and implements interventions to improve quality and safety

  • Makes appropriate evidence-based, patient-centered medication recommendations

  • Participates in the management of medical emergencies

  • Provides discharge medication review, reconciliation, and counseling as appropriate

  • Provides pharmaceutical services throughout the medical center

  • Maintains proficiency in hospital computer systems and medication ordering systems

  • Provides accurate, safe, timely, and appropriate medication therapy based on patient age and needs

  • Completes critical patient monitoring and reviews patient profile/chart to identify, prevent, or mitigate drug-related problems, improper drug or dose selection, sub-therapeutic dosage, overdosage, adverse drug reactions, drug interactions, failure to receive drugs, untreated indications, medication use without an indication, and treatment failures

  • Communicates effectively and appropriately with healthcare providers and caregivers (physicians, nurses, etc.) and assures continuity of pharmaceutical care between shifts and among staff

  • Actively participates in stewardship activities and restricted medication programs

  • Participates in pharmacy operations and medication dispensing

  • Maintains proficiency in and actively engages in operational programs, central dispensing pharmacies, satellite dispensing pharmacies, and specialty pharmacy areas as appropriate for job assignment

  • Identifies, designs, and implements improvements in the medication-use system to advance patient safety, maximize therapeutic outcomes, or control costs

  • Upon request, the Ambulatory CPS may participate in department, hospital, and campus committees and help develop and implement Clinical Pharmacy Services in assigned areas

  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Process Integration Engineer (ITL)
description:
Process Integration Engineer (ITL)
San Diego / Riverside, CA

Salary: $100,000 - $200,000

About the Role
Our client, a fast-scaling semiconductor technology company in the high-speed communications space, is seeking a Process Integration Engineer to help mature state-of-the-art devices from development into full production. This role centers on building repeatable, high-yield manufacturing processes for highly specialized photonic and semiconductor devices.

What You'll Do

  • Build and drive integration plans and schedules across established manufacturing tools and process flows
  • Own the interactions between major process modules (etch, films, litho, and others) within an integrated flow
  • Correlate final device performance to inline factory measurements, metrics, and process steps, then turn that data into reports and improvement proposals
  • Partner closely with Operations and Process Development teams to keep programs on track
  • Hold internal and external partners accountable to milestones and clear technical roadblocks
  • Analyze metrology results and disposition lots against defined pass/fail criteria

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or a related field
  • Broad, hands-on experience across dielectric and metal deposition, CMP, dry-etch, wet-etch, and photolithography
  • Working knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and statistical tools
  • Integration engineering experience in advanced semiconductor or MEMS process development (highly desired)
  • Strong technical writing and data analysis skills
  • Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Expertise across Front End (FEOL), Back End (BEOL), MEMS, photonics, or novel device integration
  • Familiarity with device physics and process/device simulation
  • Depth in photolithography, dry/wet-etch, deposition, thin films, CMP, and metrology

Work Environment
Primarily an open, temperature-controlled office setting with regular time in a manufacturing or cleanroom environment (gowning required). The role is largely sedentary but may involve occasional lifting, pushing, or pulling of items over 10 lbs, plus daily use of standard office and characterization equipment.

title: ES Benefit Specialist 3: Tax and Wage-Rates Unit/Lead-Internal Only
description:
Description



This position is mainly virtual but may be required to come into the office for occasional trainings and meetings as requested.



This position is only open to internal Employment Security Department Employees only.



The ideal candidate for the ES Benefit Specialist 3 – Lead role in our Rates section is a seasoned unemployment insurance professional who brings deep expertise in tax rates, benefit charging, and the application of complex RCWs and WACs.



They demonstrate strong analytical ability, advanced problem-solving skills, and a commitment to protecting the integrity of the UI trust fund. A healthy UI trust fund is an integral part of paying unemployment benefit to claimants. Their foundation in accounting principles, regulatory interpretation, and employer account management enables them to navigate intricate tax issues with accuracy and confidence.

This candidate excels as a trainer, mentor, and technical resource. They are skilled at developing and delivering training on tax systems, benefit charges, separation reasons, and annual tax rate assignments. The incumbent will develop and provide technical training in tax rates and benefit charges, interpreting laws & regulations, and customer service. They will coach and mentor Tax Specialists of varying abilities regarding law/policy and procedures. The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative environment, supporting team members, reviewing work for accuracy, identifying training gaps, and ensuring consistent application of policy and procedure across the Rates Unit.

Finally, the ideal candidate is a steady, reliable leader who contributes to unit performance, workflow management, and quality assurance. They are comfortable acting as a lead worker—assigning tasks, checking work, planning workloads—and stepping in for the supervisor when needed. They communicate effectively with employers, internal partners, and external stakeholders, even in challenging situations. They communicate with internal and external customers including uncooperative customers in stressful situations and provide clear guidance on regulatory requirements and appeal rights. Their adaptability, equity-focused mindset, and commitment to accuracy make them an essential contributor to the Rates Unit’s mission of ensuring employers receive correct tax rates and equitable benefit charge decisions.

Duties


Develop and provide technical training in tax rates and benefit charges, interpreting laws & regulations, and customer service. This includes:


  • Work closely with Rates supervisor to assist with training, orienting, directing, and coordinating the work of Tax Specialists


  • Perform user acceptance testing for Rates program changes to ensure the correct actions are taken without unintended consequences

description:

As a Quality Assurance (QA) Technician (3rd Shift), you will play a key role in supporting all quality and food safety aspects of production. You’ll work directly on the production floor, performing pre-operational inspections, verifying sanitation and GMP compliance, supporting production activities, and ensuring product quality standards are consistently met. You will provide hands-on support to the factory, helping identify and escalate any safety or quality concerns while contributing to the delivery of safe, high-quality products.

$22.40/hr

$1.25/hr for 3rd shift differential

Nestle Quarter Bonus

Hours; 10PM to 6AM
Days: Sunday – Friday (6 days a week)

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participate in product evaluations to ensure top quality
  • Perform other duties as assigned

  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 1–2 years of experience in manufacturing, quality control, production, or operations environment

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and stand or move throughout the shift
  • Basic proficiency of English language to comply with verbal and written directions, signs, policies and procedures. (Spanish/English bilingual is a plus)

SKILLS:

  • Detail-oriented and committed to quality
  • Ability to follow safety rules and operating procedures
  • Basic math skills and ability to use a calculator
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as manuals and safety instructions
  • Comfortable performing basic lab tasks and using standard lab equipment
  • Proficiency with using computers, tablets, and basic software (Outlook, Excel, Word)

title: Data Analytics Manager
description:
OUR STORY

TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry.

Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets, TechInsights’ content informs decision makers and professionals whose success depends on accurate knowledge of the semiconductor industry—past, present, or future.

Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market intelligence in the semiconductor industry. This collection includes detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market analysis, and expert commentary. TechInsights’ customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence. For more information, visit .

We own corporate data, corporate reporting, and ensure data is at the heart of every decision.
As our Data & Analytics Manager, you will lead a team of analysts to deliver high-impact analytics solutions while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making. You will balance hands-on analytics work with team development, strategic planning, and stakeholder management, translating business priorities and leadership vision into team objectives while championing our commitment to Impact, Speed, Repeatability, Accuracy, and Reliability.

  • Develop and execute the team’s strategic roadmap in alignment with organizational priorities and the Data & Analytics team’s mandate
  • Drive initiatives focused on operational excellence, rationalization and automation, and comprehensive documentation
  • Define and track team success metrics (Impact, Speed, Repeatability, Accuracy, Reliability); monitor, assess, and communicate team performance
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement changes that enhance team efficiency and output quality
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts, including performance management and career development

WHAT YOU’LL BRING
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field, including at least 1 year in a leadership or management role
  • Expert proficiency in data visualization and business intelligence tools; Tableau Cloud experience required, including Tableau Prep
  • Strong technical foundation in data preparation, ETL/ELT processes, data engineering concepts, modern data stack tools, and cloud data platforms
  • Advanced understanding of Large Language Models and AI tools, with the ability to guide the team in leveraging these technologies effectively
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills; able to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, including senior executives
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking; understands how analytics initiatives connect to organizational goals
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously
  • Experience establishing team processes, standards, and best practices; committed to operational excellence and documentation
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and critical thinking; comfortable navigating ambiguity and making informed decisions with incomplete information
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and learning; models a growth mindset and encourages innovation
  • Experience with the Atlassian suite of collaborative software preferred
  • Passion for data quality, accuracy, and ensuring analytics outputs are usable, actionable, and trustworthy

As part of the recruitment process for this position, you will be required to submit your latest citizenship and/or permanent residency information. This information will be used to comply with U.S. Export Control Laws and Regulations.

title: Visitor Safety and Engagement Specialist
description:
What We Can Achieve Together:

The Visitor Safety and Engagement Specialist (VSES) is a land stewardship team member whose work primarily focuses on our 1,900-acre Lucius Pond Ordway-Devil’s Den Preserve in Weston and Redding, CT. This position tends to multiple preserves across the Saugatuck Forest Lands management unit in southwest Connecticut, may work with volunteers, and is directly supervised by the Director of Saugatuck Preserves. Integrating best practices for engaging a broad audience in the body of work that encompasses land stewardship is an important component of this position. The schedule includes weekend hours at our Devil’s Den & Saugatuck Forest Lands office.

This is a Hybrid position with an expectation of several days per week working from our Devil's Den Preserve. There is flexibility for some remote work as well. There is an expectation for some weekend working days as well, at times.


We’re Looking for You:

TNC’s Connecticut Chapter offers competitive compensation, excellent benefits, a 401 (k) retirement plan with employer matching contribution for eligible employees, flexible schedule and office location arrangements, and a collaborative work environment. We prioritize professional development and promote from within. You will find a culture here at TNC that both inspires conservation achievement and supports personal growth, in the workplace and beyond.

The VSES focuses on preserve visitation and advances land stewardship with the important goal of creating and supporting safe and positive experiences for people with a range of abilities, interests, and backgrounds and ensuring TNC’s properties meet ecological and cultural goals.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3 years’ experience in natural resource management or similar field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Relationship building experience to work closely with a variety of partners, i.e., media, government officials, internal scientists.
  • Experience completing tasks independently with respect to timeline(s).
  • Experience with communication via written, spoken and graphical means in English and other relevant languages.
  • Experience using common software applications such as Word, Excel, web browsers, etc.
  • Experience in training.
  • Must have valid driver's license.

Desired Qualifications

  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.
  • Experience with conflict resolution.
  • 3-5 years’ experience in natural resource management, similar field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability and willingness to apply science to decision-making and guide activities.
  • Experience operating and repairing various types of equipment and machinery.
  • Knowledge of ecological land management principles.
  • Knowledge of current trends and practices in conservation, land management and natural resource preservation.

title: Restoration Monitoring Specialist
description:
Your Position with TNC :


The OMP Restoration Monitoring Specialist works within The Nature Conservancy’s Ohio Stream and Wetland Mitigation Program (OMP) which utilizes mitigation funds to locate and develop restoration projects in the state of Ohio that maximize success and conservation outcomes for the State’s dynamic watersheds. The Restoration Monitoring Specialist coordinates and conducts ecological monitoring for numerous OMP restoration projects across the state of Ohio. They will find a culture that supports and inspires conservation achievement and personal development, celebrates innovation, values collaborative approaches, and seeks lasting conservation results.


Essential Functions:

The position’s primary responsibilities are planning, contracting, coordinating, reporting, and implementing various ecological monitoring for OMP restoration projects, including, but not limited to: geomorphological surveys, vegetation assessments, fish and macroinvertebrate sampling, wetland delineations, and hydrological monitoring for stream, wetland, and riparian buffer habitats. The Restoration Monitoring Specialist works collaboratively with other OMP staff, TNC staff, staff from the US Army Corps of Engineers, Ohio EPA, Ohio Interagency Review Team and other organizations, and individuals as needed in carrying out duties.



Responsibilities & Scope:

  • Lead implementation of ecological monitoring plans for OMP restoration projects across Ohio, in coordination with Restoration Ecologists who are responsible for project management and performance standards.
  • Develop scopes of work, requests for bids, and contracts for monitoring services, including vegetation, hydrology, geomorphology, and other ecological metrics.
  • Work withing monitoring budgets and support contractor selection, and contract negotiations to ensure high-quality, cost-effective services.
  • Provide coordination, oversight, and quality assurance of contractors and consultants, ensuring adherence to approved methodologies, schedules, and data quality expectations.
  • Perform regular site visits throughout Ohio to evaluate success and identify potential issues with OMP restoration projects.
  • Collect piezometer data, troubleshoot data loggers, and collect photographs at project photo monitoring points.
  • Analyze monitoring data and prepare monitoring reports in coordination with Restoration Ecologists who evaluate site performance against regulatory and programmatic success criteria.
  • Conduct field-based ecological assessments, as capacity allows, to support project planning, compliance, and adaptive management.
  • Apply a strong working knowledge of OMP operations, regulatory requirements, and performance standards to ensure monitoring efforts are aligned with project and program goals.
  • Collaborate with Restoration Ecologists to identify and recommend adaptive management and corrective actions needed to achieve project objectives.
  • Assist with limited restoration stewardship/adaptive management tasks such as spot spraying of invasives, supplemental planting, etc.


Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree and 3 years’ experience in natural resource management or similar field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Technical writing experience.
  • Experience completing tasks independently with respect to timeline(s).
  • Experience with communication via written, spoken and graphical means in English.
  • Experience using common software applications such as Word, Excel, web browsers, etc.
  • Experience managing staff, volunteers, or contractors.
  • Must have, or be able to obtain, valid driver's license.

Desired Qualifications (Examples)


  • Knowledge of land management conservation practice and conservation science.
  • Experience with contract preparation, contractor oversight, and contract and budget management
  • Experience working within project budgets
  • Experience in performing or interpreting, or a willingness to learn:
  • stream geomorphological surveys cross-sections and longitudinal profiles
  • stream biology surveys such as macroinvertebrate and fish sampling.
  • wetland delineations
  • vegetation assessments such as VIBI, and ability to identify Ohio’s common flora and fauna
  • Experience with invasive plant management and/or native forest restoration.
  • Excellent communication skills via written, spoken and graphical means in English and other relevant languages.
  • Experience using applications such as Microsoft Office Suite, ESRI GIS/Field Maps software, and , RiverMorph, GPS.

title: Software Engineer – AI Systems
description:
Software Engineer – AI Systems

Location: Hybrid - Irvine, CA

Job Type: Full-Time

Mutual of Omaha is a Fortune 300 Company. Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is inspired by hometown values and a commitment to being responsible and caring for each other. We exist for the benefit of our customers and employees.

Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is a full-service lending company offering both Forward and Reverse Mortgage products including a complete line of residential mortgage, refinancing, specialty, and HECM loans. We employ a knowledgeable staff of experienced Loan Officers with an operations team that is second to none. If you are interested in joining a team that promotes from within and works together toward a common goal of helping customers with their mortgage needs, please review and apply for our opening below!

Overview:

We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer with a strong focus on AI systems to join our team. This role centers on designing, building, and maintaining AI-driven services and agentic workflows, with hands-on Anthropic SDK/API experience as a core requirement. The ideal candidate blends prompt engineering skill, comfort building and debugging agentic loops, and solid full-stack fundamentals (Python, TypeScript/React, SQL). This person should think about both software-engineering discipline and AI-system behavior: testing, scaling, and securing AI-backed applications the same way any production system would be.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, deploy web applications, AI-driven services and agentic pipelines (tool-use loops, multi-step agents, orchestration)
  • Build and maintain integrations with Anthropic API/SDK (Claude models, tool use, prompt caching, streaming)
  • Write, iterate, and evaluate prompts for reliability, safety, and cost efficiency
  • Develop RESTful APIs (Python) and React/TypeScript front ends around AI features
  • Own DevOps for AI services: CI/CD, containerization (Docker), cloud deploy (AWS/Azure), monitoring/observability for agent runs
  • Write optimized SQL against relational DBs
  • Design automated test frameworks for both deterministic code and non-deterministic AI outputs (eval harnesses, regression suites)
  • Collaborate cross-functional with teams and translate business needs into AI-backed technical solutions
  • Maintain technical docs (architecture, prompt design decisions, agent behavior/limits)

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 2+ years of experience working with Python and Flask or Django
  • Must-have: Hands on experience with Anthropic SDK/API and Claude Console
  • Proficiency with Git
  • Strong experience with RESTful API development
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., MySQL, MSSQL, Postgres)
  • Comfortable building and debugging agentic loops (tool-call cycles, multi-turn agents, error recovery, self-verification patterns)
  • Judgment to scope an AI solution appropriately — knows when multi-agent orchestration is overkill versus warranted
  • Some DevOps exposure: Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms like AWS or Azure
  • Proficiency with Git
  • Familiarity with testing libraries (pytest, jest); LLM eval framework experience a plus
  • Strong debugging skills for complex, partially non-deterministic systems
  • Excellent communication skills: ability to explain AI behavior, limits, and tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Stays current with the broader AI landscape — local/open-source models, emerging tooling, and alternatives to hosted APIs — and can speak to tradeoffs (cost, latency, privacy, quality) between running a model locally versus calling a hosted API

The annual salary for this position is $135,000–$150,000. This position offers eligibility for incentive compensation.

Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage diverse, talented, qualified applicants to apply. We offer an extensive compensation package. Benefits include:

  • Vacation — Vacation hours accrue on a per pay period basis. Balance maximums are based on years of service.

  • 9 Paid Holidays + 1 Cultural Celebration Day (Floating Holiday)
  • Multiple PPO Medical Plans, as well as HDHP eligible plan.

  • Vision Coverage
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • 401K with a generous employer match
  • Additional Benefits including – Optional Life, FSA, Pet Insurance etc.
  • Free Legal Services
  • Employee Loan Program

title: Educador(a) Clínico(a) - Enfermagem
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

A Vantive é uma empresa de terapia de órgãos vitais com a missão de prolongar vidas e expandir possibilidades a pacientes e equipes de cuidado em todo mundo. Por 70 anos, nossa equipe tem impulsionado inovações significativas em cuidado renal. À medida que construímos o nosso legado, aprofundamos o nosso compromisso de elevar a experiência da diálise por meio de soluções digitais e serviços avançados, olhando além do cuidado renal e investindo na transformação das terapias para órgãos vitais. Maior flexibilidade e eficiência na administração da terapia para as equipes de cuidado, e vidas mais longas e plenas para os pacientes – é isso que a Vantive aspira proporcionar.

Acreditamos que a Vantive não somente consolidará a nossa liderança na área de cuidados renais, como também oferecerá um trabalho significativo àqueles que se juntarem a nós. Na Vantive, você fará parte de uma comunidade de pessoas focadas, corajosas e que não se contentam com a mediocridade.

Cada um de nós é motivado a ajudar a melhorar a vida dos pacientes em todo mundo. Junte-se a nós avançando em nossa missão de prolongar vidas e expandir possibilidades.

Seu papel na Vantive

O/A Educador(a) Clínico(a) é responsável por orientar pacientes e suas famílias sobre as diferentes modalidades terapêuticas disponíveis para o tratamento de sua condição clínica renal. Em parceria com as equipes de enfermagem e médica, fornece informações neutras, claras e baseadas em evidências. Essa função não envolve promoção de produtos ou marcas e deve seguir estritamente todos os padrões éticos e regulatórios aplicáveis ao ambiente hospitalar.

O que você fará

  • Realizar visitas presenciais a hospitais autorizados;
  • Oferecer sessões educacionais individuais ou em grupo para pacientes hospitalizados e suas famílias, explicando de forma acessível as diversas modalidades terapêuticas disponíveis;
  • Apoiar a equipe clínica do hospital na disseminação de informações técnicas sobre terapias e práticas de cuidado;
  • Colaborar com a equipe interna de educação clínica e parceiros institucionais na melhoria contínua do conteúdo e das metodologias educacionais;
  • Garantir que toda comunicação permaneça educativa e não promocional e em conformidade com as políticas de Conformidade, Ética, Regulamentação de Saúde (ANVISA) e Privacidade de Dados (LGPD).

O que você trará

  • Ensino superior completo em Enfermagem. Desejável especialização na área de Nefrologia;
  • Conhecimento técnico nas diferentes modalidades de tratamento renal, em especial Hemodiálise (HD), Diálise Peritonial (DP) e Transplante;

title: Senior REO Specialist
description:
Selene Holdings is a multiple-lines business financial services firm with a mortgage servicing company, a loan diligence company, a title company, an insurance brokerage, and a real estate owned company. We have office locations in Dallas, TX, Jacksonville, FL, and Salt Lake City, UT. Founded in 2007 to address needs in the mortgage industry, Selene strives to provide amazing client and borrower experiences. A positive attitude coupled with proven creative thinking and actions are all attributes we seek in every one of our employees. If you want to make a difference, then Selene is the place for you!

The REO Asset Manager is responsible for managing a portfolio of Real Estate Owned (REO) assets throughout the disposition lifecycle, with a focus on maximizing investor returns, minimizing carrying costs, and ensuring compliance with company policies, investor requirements, and applicable regulations. This position requires strong analytical skills, vendor management experience, and the ability to effectively manage timelines, asset strategies, and disposition activities across a diverse portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Asset & Portfolio Management

  • Manage the disposition of a portfolio of REO assets from acquisition through final sale.
  • Develop and execute asset-specific strategies designed to maximize recovery and minimize expenses.
  • Review appraisals, Broker Price Opinions (BPOs), and market data to establish asset valuations and disposition strategies.
  • Monitor market conditions and asset performance to make informed recommendations regarding pricing, marketing, and disposition activities.
  • Ensure all assets are managed in compliance with investor, company, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain ownership of assigned assets and drive resolutions within established service level expectations.

Vendor & Process Management

  • Oversee and manage third-party vendors, including brokers, property preservation companies, valuation providers, and closing agents.
  • Maintain a hands-on approach to internal processes and vendor performance management.
  • Monitor timelines and milestones to ensure timely sale and disposition of assets.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting is received, reviewed, and distributed to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate issues that may impact recovery, compliance, or asset disposition timelines.

Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and recommend process enhancements.
  • Remain current on federal and state mortgage servicing regulations, investor requirements, and industry best practices impacting REO operations.
  • Support departmental initiatives, audits, and special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 3+ years of REO Asset Management, Default Servicing, Loss Mitigation, or Mortgage Servicing experience.
  • Strong knowledge of REO disposition processes, investor requirements, property valuation methodologies, and default servicing operations.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple assets, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment while maintaining a high degree of confidentiality.
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to build productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree or higher from an accredited college or university.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Real Estate, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, including real estate brokers, preservation companies, and valuation providers.
  • Familiarity with agency, government, GSE, and private investor requirements related to REO asset disposition.
  • Prior experience within mortgage servicing, default servicing, foreclosure, bankruptcy, or loss mitigation environments.
  • Experience working with investor scorecards, timelines, and performance metrics.
  • Strong understanding of REO timelines, investor guidelines, and property preservation practices.
  • Experience with REO management platforms such as Equator, Pyramid, or similar systems.

Technical Skills

Required

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Preferred

  • MSP

  • Black Knight/LPS

  • Other mortgage servicing and default management platforms

Competencies

  • Ability to prioritize competing demands and meet deadlines

  • Effective communication and relationship-building skills
  • Results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

title: Staff RN - Heather's House - Nights
description:
Come feel the difference at Heather's House!

There is something special and different about this Heather's House. It's how we care for patients and families and in how our team shows up for each other every day. All nursing care, as approved by patients’ primary physicians or the hospice medical director, including physical assessments, symptom management, and emotional support.

Eligible for up to a 10k Sign-on bonus

description:

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

Program:

  • May assist in the kitchen and as needed

PUBLIC RELATIONS:

HEALTH, SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL:

  • Ensure that proper safety precautions and hygiene standards are followed including Universal Precautions.

  • Ensures high standards of sanitation and cleanliness are maintained throughout the kitchen, foodbank, dining room and food storage areas including removing kitchen & dining room waste.

  • Demonstrate a high standard of personal hygiene.

  • May be required to ensure that the building is secure and that safety standards are met or exceeded at all times.

  • Participate in monthly workplace inspections and staff meetings

  • Ocean Crest has had long-standing policies of providing a safe and healthy workplace, protecting the environment, and conserving energy and natural resources. Every employee is expected to follow the policy and to report any environmental, health or safety concern or suggestion for improving our environmental impact to their manager

All above responsibilities must be discharged in accordance with The Salvation Army’s Mission Statement, in a professional manner, upholding our code of conduct.

The incumbent’s work environment is typically in the Center of Hope

·Dirt/dust/ temperature variations

·Work-related stress

·Upset people and challenging behaviours

·Verbal abuse

·Temperature ( hot / cold )

·Noisy

·The incumbent may have some travel requirements.

  • Physical attacks by others (i.e. violent/aggressive clients)
  • Exposure to infectious diseases
  • Risk of back strain
  • Emergency Response situations (fire, bomb threat, etc.)
  • Other potentially dangerous situations
  • Exposure to toxic chemicals
  • Moving objects
  • Sharp objects

The incumbent must take the following precautionary measures (in addition to health and safety rules):

  • Universal Precautions
  • Food Safe Levels 1
  • First Aid Level 1
  • Use gloves provided when necessary
  • Immunization for Hepatitis B, and vaccination against Tuberculosis and COVID are recommended
  • Non-violent crisis intervention training

The above responsibilities must be discharged in accordance with The Salvation Army’s Mission Statement, in a professional manner, upholding our code of conduct.

Education, Experience, AND Qualifications:

  • Willingness to develop an understanding and support for the mission and purpose of The Salvation Army in Canada and its implications as related to position responsibilities.

  • Work in compliance with OH&S Act and Regulations and abide by The Salvation Army’s health and safety policies and procedures.

  • Ability to provide an original copy of a Background Check that is satisfactory to The Salvation Army, in its sole discretion, is required, including Child Check (if appropriate).

  • WHIMIS and Universal Precautions Training

  • Online New Hire Health and Safety courses

  • Naloxone Training

  • Link 2 Feed Super User Training

  • Other training as required by contract or The Salvation Army

  • Non-Violent Crisis Intervention

  • NOTE: An alternative level of education and experience may be acceptable.
  • Food Safe Level I
  • First Aid Certification
  • Fluent spoken and written English
  • Valid Driver’s license and clean driver’s abstract
  • Excellent team and interpersonal skills
  • Able to handle physical demands, which include lifting/carrying of items more than 20 pounds...
  • Immunization for Hepatitis B, and vaccination against Tuberculosis – suggested
  • Criminal Record Check

Experience and Knowledge:

The incumbent must have the following experience before hire:

  • Minimum 1 year of prior related experience, including experience working with multi-barriered persons

PHYSICAL EFFORT/DEXTERITY REQUIRED:

The performance of the job requires a moderated amount of loading/unloading vehicles, sorting donated goods, computer work, and record & database maintenance & intervening in physical confrontations. The incumbent is required to lift more than 20 pounds.

CONCENTRATION REQUIRED:

The performance of the job requires attentive listening (empathy to clients/volunteers/co-workers), ability to give directions or guidance, and attention to computer work.

title: Infrastructure and data centre senior engineer
description:
Company Overview

1-grid is a fast-growing web hosting company in Cape Town with an established customer base, recently acquired by recognized leaders in the Internet services industry. We have the vision and resources to be the market leader in SA in the next 5 years; this vision is supported by an entrepreneurial culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, and top performance.

Role Purpose

The Infrastructure and Data Center Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of 1-grid’s data center operations, ensuring high availability, security, efficiency, and scalability of hosting and colocation services. This role oversees physical infrastructure, people, vendors, and processes, including the procurement, lifecycle management, and optimisation of data center hardware and equipment.

Key Responsibilities Data Center Operations Manage daily operations of the data center to ensure 24/7/365 availability of hosting services. Oversee critical infrastructure including power, cooling, fire suppression, cabling, racks, and physical security systems. Ensure compliance with uptime targets, SLAs, and internal operational standards. Develop, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintenance schedules, and emergency response plans. Infrastructure, Capacity & Hardware Management Plan and manage space, power, cooling, and rack capacity to support current and future business needs. Coordinate installation, migration, and decommissioning of servers, networking equipment, storage, and customer hardware. Maintain accurate documentation of infrastructure layouts and dependencies. Hardware Procurement & Asset Lifecycle Management Lead the procurement of data center hardware, including servers, storage, networking equipment, racks, PDUs, cabling, and spare parts. Work closely with finance, engineering, and vendors to ensure cost-effective, scalable, and standardised hardware solutions. Manage supplier selection, quotations, purchase orders, and delivery timelines. Ensure hardware purchases align with capacity planning, technical standards, and business growth forecasts. Maintain full asset lifecycle management, including inventory tracking, warranty management, refresh cycles, and secure disposal. Identify opportunities to optimise hardware spend, improve utilisation, and reduce total cost of ownership. Security, Risk & Compliance Ensure physical and operational compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC, PCI-DSS, and internal security policies. Manage physical access controls, monitoring systems, and visitor procedures. Conduct regular risk assessments and ensure mitigation plans are implemented and reviewed. Incident, Change & Problem Management Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and outages, leading response and resolution activities. Coordinate root cause analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews. Manage change control processes for data center and hardware-related changes to minimise risk and disruption. Vendor & Stakeholder Management Manage relationships with hardware vendors, OEMs, distributors, maintenance providers, and facilities contractors. Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and contractual obligations. Collaborate with internal teams including network, systems, cloud, customer support, sales, and finance. People Management Lead, coach, and develop data center technicians and facilities staff. Ensure adequate staffing, shift coverage, and on-call rotations. Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, operational excellence, and customer focus. Financial & Budget Management Own and manage the data center operational budget (OPEX) and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning. Forecast hardware and infrastructure costs based on growth and refresh cycles. Track spend against budget and identify cost-saving initiatives without compromising service quality. Minimum Requirements Qualifications Diploma or Degree in IT, Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline. Relevant certifications such as CDCP, CDCS, ITIL, ISO 27001, or similar (advantageous). Experience 8-10 years’ experience in data center operations, and hosting environment. Proven experience managing hardware procurement and vendor relationships. Experience leading operational or technical teams in a mission‑critical environment. Technical & Professional Skills Strong understanding of data center infrastructure, power and cooling systems, and redundancy models (N+1, 2 N). Solid knowledge of servers, storage, networking, virtualization, and hosting platforms. Experience with inventory, asset management, and procurement processes. Strong analytical, planning, and problem‑solving skills. Advanced technical troubleshooting skills for network and server hardware. Personal Attributes Calm, decisive, and resilient under pressure. Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Highly organised with strong attention to detail. Commercially minded with a continuous improvement mindset. Values Alignment

The Infrastructure and Data Centre Manager is expected to live out and promote the values: Accountability, Customer Centric, Teamwork, Inclusivity, Respect, Transparency, Quality and Collaboration #J-18808-Ljbffr
