title: Engineering Operations Technician
description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: R&D Scientist
description:
Are you looking to power the next leap in the exciting world of advanced electronics? Do you want to help solve problems that drive success in the rapidly evolving technology and connectivity landscape? Then bring your problem-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics.

At Qnity, we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high-tech industries – we’re a tight-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting-edge technology possible. We value forward-thinking challengers, boundary-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us.

Position Summary

Qnity is seeking an R&D Scientist to join our Advanced Circuits & Packaging (ACP) team in Marlborough, Massachusetts. The ACP organization develops innovative materials and technologies that address critical challenges in the global semiconductor packaging and circuit manufacturing industries.

This role is ideal for a scientist with expertise in polymer and organic chemistry, materials science, and formulation development who enjoys hands-on laboratory work and collaborating with global technical teams.

The successful candidate will contribute to the development of next-generation electroplating products through polymer synthesis, formulation design, materials characterization, process scale-up, and electrochemical testing. In addition to working within cross-functional teams, this individual will lead focused technical projects and serve as a resource for less experienced team members.

This is a 100% onsite position based in our Marlborough, MA facility.

Please note: Sponsorship is not available now or in the future for this opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Support research and development of new additives and formulations used in electroplating products for the electronics industry

  • Collaborate with global technical and commercial teams on product development projects

  • Perform polymer synthesis and characterization at laboratory and pilot scales

  • Design and execute experiments involving electroplating, electrochemistry, chromatography, microscopy, NMR, and materials testing

  • Collect, analyze, interpret, and communicate experimental results to internal and external stakeholders

  • Prepare samples, support scale-up activities, and contribute to process development efforts

  • Lead focused technical projects with minimal supervision

  • Maintain strict adherence to safety protocols and actively participate in laboratory safety initiatives

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant industry or research experience

  • Hands-on experience with wet chemistry techniques and laboratory experimentation

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and test technical hypotheses and operate standard chemical and analytical instrumentation

  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, or materials chemistry

  • Experience with polymer synthesis and characterization

  • Knowledge of electroplating bath formulation, electrochemistry, or electrodeposition processes

  • Experience using analytical techniques such as NMR, chromatography, cyclic voltammetry, spectroscopy, and titration methods

  • Strong understanding of statistical analysis and Design of Experiments (DOE)

  • Experience supporting semiconductor, electronics, or advanced materials applications

title: Senior Data Program Manager
description:
Scientific Games:

Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. From cutting-edge backend systems to exciting entertainment experiences and trailblazing retail and digital solutions, we elevate play every day. We push game designs to the next level and are pioneers in data analytics and iLottery. Built on a foundation of trusted partnerships, Scientific Games combines relentless innovation, legendary performance, and unwavering security to responsibly propel the global lottery industry ever forward.

Position Summary

Job Summary:

Owns the translation of roadmap and product definitions into executable work across Data Products & Analytics, Platform Engineering, and Data Science/ML. Makes execution predictable through better artifacts, not more process — usable epics, cross-board visibility, and a tight program rhythm. Does not direct PE or DS sprint work, is not a status-tracking role, and carries this as an individual contributor.

Scope:

Owns epic quality, cross-board visibility, and the DP&A program rhythm across the DP&A, DS, and PE boards, working as an individual contributor. Reports to the Senior Director, Data Products & Analytics.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Convert roadmap items and product definitions into epics sized for DS and PE sprint planning

  • Draft independently, then iterate with technical leads before work goes on a board

  • Own epic structure, acceptance criteria, sequence, and dependencies — implementation detail stays with technical leads

  • Hold a Ready-to-Execute standard: three clarifying questions means the epic wasn’t ready

  • Track active work across the DP&A, DS, and PE boards; give a coherent picture of what’s in flight, blocked, or at risk

  • Identify sequencing conflicts and cross-team dependencies before they become sprint blockers

  • Own the Jira process and sprint cadence for the Data Products & Analytics team

  • Facilitate planning, review, and retro ceremonies — decision-oriented, not status-reporting exercises

  • Manage the backlog so what’s in Jira reflects what the team is actually trying to do

  • Set the standard for epic and process quality that other contributors follow across DP&A — without a reporting relationship

Qualifications

Qualifications / Skills / Knowledge:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; Agile/Scrum or PMP certification a plus

  • 7+ years in program or project management within a data or software delivery context, with deep hands-on ownership (people-management experience not required)

  • Program management depth — knows what makes an epic actually usable

  • Technical grounding without engineering scope — enough to draft an epic a senior engineer can work from, pending iteration

  • Cross-functional operating instincts — visibility across teams they don’t control, without creating overhead

  • Jira fluency as a process designer, not just a user — board structure, epic standards, a backlog tied to real priorities

  • Strong written communication — artifacts clear enough to act on without a meeting

  • Influence without authority — holds others to a quality standard (e.g., Ready-to-Execute) with no reporting relationship

Desired

  • Experience designing process across multiple teams

  • Exposure to data, analytics, or ML delivery environments

Authority / Decision Making:

Authority To

  • Set the epic and Ready-to-Execute standard for DP&A work

  • Own the DP&A Jira process, board structure, and sprint cadence

  • Sequence work and flag cross-team dependencies and program risks

Requires Approval For

  • Roadmap priorities and commitments (owned by the Director/Senior Director)

  • Changes to Platform Engineering or DS sprint scope (owned by their leads)

Key Contacts

Internal:

  • Senior Director, Data Products & Analytics

  • Data Products leadership

  • Platform Engineering leads

  • Data Science/ML leads

External:

  • Atlassian/Jira tooling vendors (as needed)

  • External engineering and development teams

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, bend, use hands, operate a computer, and have specific vision abilities to include close and distance vision, and ability to adjust focus working with computer and business equipment.


Work Conditions

Scientific Games, LLC and its affiliates (collectively, “SG”) are engaged in highly regulated gaming and lottery businesses. As a result, certain SG employees may, among other things, be required to obtain a gaming or other license(s), undergo background investigations or security checks, or meet certain standards dictated by law, regulation or contracts. In order to ensure SG complies with its regulatory and contractual commitments, as a condition to hiring and continuing to employ its employees, SG requires all of its employees to meet those requirements that are necessary to fulfill their individual roles. As a prerequisite to employment with SG (to the extent permitted by law), you shall be asked to consent to SG conducting a due diligence/background investigation on you.

It is responsible for ensuring the health, safety, and well-being of all North Carolinians, providing human service needs for special populations including individuals who are deaf, blind, developmentally disabled, and mentally ill, and helping poor North Carolinians achieve economic independence.

This position works within the Transportation Department and functions as provider of medical care and transport to various hospitals and medical facilities for appointments and procedures. Additional responsibilities include transporting patients on campus to Medical Clinic, Dental Clinic, Laboratory, X-ray, Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy.
When on off-campus medical trips, this position assists medical staff with patient behavior management and assists with compliance with examinations. Medical providers are not always experienced in caring for patients with IDD and this position assists in making the resident more comfortable and at ease while relating to the provider any special needs. This position is responsible for assisting people that live at Murdoch Developmental Center into vehicles (ambulatory, non-ambulatory, wheelchairs) and transporting to scheduled destinations. The North Carolina Department of Commerce is the state's lead agency for economic, community and workforce development. The department works with local, regional, national and international organizations to fulfill its mission to improve the economic well-being and quality of life for all North Carolinians.

The Department connects businesses with the site locations, workforce and infrastructure they need to succeed in one of the nation's top states for business. We also connect local communities with the grants and funding they need to attract new business and ensure future prosperity.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities/Management Preferences

description:

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

title: Botox Office  Coordinator
description:
SUMMARY:

The Botox Office Coordinator serves as the primary operational and administrative contact for a high-volume Neurology practice providing Botox treatments, EEG, EMG, infusion, and general clinic services across multiple ambulatory sites. This role is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the Botox program, including prior authorizations, medication procurement, specialty pharmacy coordination, buy-and-bill management, patient scheduling, and insurance verification, and acts as the central point of contact for providers, clinical staff, patients, vendors, specialty pharmacies, and insurance carriers.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization’s values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

  • Coordinate daily administrative and operational aspects of the Botox treatment program across multiple ambulatory sites.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for providers and staff across multiple practice locations, and serve as a point of escalation for staff
  • Facilitates daily workflow, including assigning work and creating staffing schedules
  • Schedule Botox medication procurement, ensuring adequate stock levels for scheduled procedures.
  • Identify medication sourcing requirements, including Specialty Pharmacy versus Buy-and-Bill procurement pathways.
  • Monitor authorization expiration dates and treatment schedules to ensure Botox administration occurs within payer-required timeframes, including the standard treatment interval of three months and one day.
  • Obtain, track, and maintain prior authorizations (PAs) for Botox and other specialty medications.
  • Coordinate specialty medication ordering, delivery, inventory monitoring, and storage requirements.
  • Act as liaison between patients, insurance carriers, specialty pharmacies, and Allergan.
  • Educate patients regarding the Botox Savings Program and available financial assistance resources.
  • Assist patients with enrollment applications and provide comprehensive follow-up throughout the approval process.
  • Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, authorizations, referrals, and coverage requirements.
  • Identify referral requirements and ensure validity of location, visit dates, and approved visit counts.
  • Serve as the practice-level resource for coding questions and billing-related issues.
  • Identify and track third-party claim rejection types and trends to support process improvements.
  • Schedule and coordinate Botox appointments while ensuring compliance with treatment timing requirements.
  • Notify patients of appointment changes and perform appointment confirmations.
  • Coordinate provider schedules, room assignments, and daily clinic workflow.

description:
As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.


Why Join Q2?

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. SUMMARY

Q2 is seeking a Cloud Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Engineering organization. As part of the Azure-focused cloud engineering team, you will help build, operate, and improve secure, reliable cloud infrastructure and platform services that support business-critical applications.

Our team collaborates closely with application engineering, DevOps, security, architecture, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable cloud environments, improve developer productivity, and strengthen the reliability, observability, and operational maturity of our platforms across Azure and AWS.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and platform services with Azure as the primary cloud platform.
  • Support AWS-based infrastructure and multi-cloud initiatives; candidates with limited AWS experience should be willing to learn and build proficiency.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform to improve consistency, repeatability, and operational efficiency.
  • Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot containerized workloads and platform services using Kubernetes, with hands-on experience in AKS and/or EKS strongly valued.
  • Partner with development and DevOps teams to integrate cloud infrastructure, platform services, and automation into CI/CD workflows.
  • Monitor production environments, troubleshoot infrastructure and platform issues, and participate in incident response to minimize downtime and improve service reliability.
  • Develop automation using scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell to reduce manual work and improve operational consistency.
  • Implement observability practices, including monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and tracing, to improve platform visibility and operational response.
  • Support cloud security, compliance, vulnerability remediation, backup, disaster recovery, and governance practices in partnership with security and infrastructure teams.
  • Contribute to reliability improvements, capacity planning, cost optimization, documentation, and continuous improvement of platform engineering practices.

EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of related experience.
  • Hands-on experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services and platform engineering practices.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services is preferred; candidates without deep AWS experience should be open to learning and supporting AWS environments.
  • Proficient with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools, especially Terraform and modern CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience running or supporting production workloads in Kubernetes and Docker, including hands-on work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as AKS and/or EKS.
  • Understanding of cloud networking concepts such as virtual networks/VPCs, DNS, routing, load balancing, private connectivity, firewalls, and security groups/network security groups.
  • Experience with identity, access management, secrets management, encryption, and least-privilege cloud security practices.
  • Proficient with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell.
  • Experience with observability tools and cloud monitoring best practices, such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Strong troubleshooting, incident response, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills in production cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, disaster recovery, backup, and compliance practices is preferred.

This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.

MiniMed is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Strategic Sourcing Specialist -IT & Professional Services to support the organization's technology sourcing, contracting, supplier management, and procurement transformation initiatives.

This individual will play a critical role in driving business value through strategic sourcing initiatives, complex RFPs, supplier negotiations, contract execution, and stakeholder partnership across a broad portfolio of technology spend, including software, cloud solutions, infrastructure, hardware, telecommunications, digital solutions, and technology-related professional services.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that requires a sourcing professional who can independently lead complex initiatives while effectively balancing a significant volume of daily sourcing, contracting, supplier management, and stakeholder support activities. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to the Senior Sourcing Managers and business leaders, helping to execute category strategies, support organizational priorities, and drive procurement excellence.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong business acumen, exercises sound judgment, and can seamlessly shift between strategic projects and urgent operational needs while maintaining exceptional customer service and stakeholder engagement.

  • Manage complex RFP, RFQ, and supplier selection processes, driving value, cost optimization, innovation, and risk mitigation.
  • Negotiate and execute contracts, statements of work, amendments, renewals, and other commercial agreements.

  • Proven experience sourcing software, cloud solutions, infrastructure, telecommunications, hardware, and technology-related professional services.

Nice to have

title: Sr Chemical Management Specialist
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, Fluctuating Temps hot/cold, Laboratory Setting, Loud Noises (Equipment/Machinery), Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Strong Odors (chemical, lubricants, biological products etc.), Various outside weather conditions, Warehouse, Will work with hazardous/toxic materials

Job Description

When you’re part of the team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do important work. And you’ll have the opportunity for continual growth and learning in a culture that empowers your development. With revenues of more than $40 billion and the largest investment in R&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and opportunities to make significant contributions to the world.

Discover Impactful Work:

Join our close-knit Chemical Management team in Unity Lab Services, where we provide integrated lab services, support, and supply management tailored to our customers' unique needs. You will serve as the first point of contact for Chemical Management, Shipping and Ordering as well as Recycling Coordination to help our clients focus on research. You will also provide cross-coverage in other logistic tasks for the site as needed. You will promote a safe and constantly improving work environment by participating in site safety programs, cost savings analysis, and process improvement initiatives.

A day in the Life:

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Chemical Management: register incoming chemicals and gas cylinders to internal system library, coordinate pickups, perform monthly chemical inventory in lab areas, remove registered materials from the system upon disposal, coordinate HHM disposal.

  • Shipping: Support domestic and international shipping operations, including courier communications, packing, labeling and administrative process for shipment in compliance with requirement.

  • Dry Ice Management: Perform dry ice order placement and replenishment at designated locations. Ensure adequate stock per container size and timely deliveries.

  • Inventory Ordering: Place orders based on inventory scan results and client requests to maintain appropriate onsite point of use inventory levels and support client needs.

  • Recycling Coordination: Prepare and organize materials for recycling, including setting up collection boxes on pallets, packaging full boxes with required documentation, and coordinating pickups with offsite vendors.

  • Receiving: receive and store incoming biological samples in appropriate temperature locations, handle dry ice, and collapse or recycle packaging material as needed.

  • Pipette Management: coordinate on site and off site pipette servicing by collecting pipettes, record details in log, and contact vendor to facilitate visit or ship to warehouse.

  • Glasswash and Autoclave: perform daily pickup of dirty glassware from labs, run washer and autoclave cycles to sterilize lab materials, redistribute clean glassware to storage areas.

  • Non-Hazardous Waste Bulking: Pick up plastic bottles of non-hazardous media waste from designated lab locations, routine bulking of non-hazardous waste from labs into large waste drum.

  • Capture and report job specific metrics to Site Supervisor and maintain good record-keeping.

Education:

High school diploma or equivalent required.

Education in a relevant field preferred.

Experience:

Minimum 1-2 years of customer-service experience in a laboratory, warehouse, or similar environment.

Schedule:

• 8 hour shifts, hourly position
• Monday to Friday schedule

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications (Excel, Outlook, Teams).

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a safety-first approach.

  • Ability to read and understand SDS documentation and DOT labeling requirements.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Physical Requirements / Work Environment

  • The role primarily involves working independently at customer sites, which may include areas with chemical-based allergens like penicillin and tetracycline.

  • Personal protective equipment, such as lab coats, coveralls, facemasks, and steel-toe shoes, is often required.

  • The position requires regular lifting of 30-40 lbs (up to 50 lbs occasionally) and using equipment like pushcarts and forklifts to move up to 100 lbs.

  • Standing, walking, and manual material handling of chemical containers are frequent activities, sometimes in varied temperature environments.

  • Overtime work may also be necessary.

  • As a condition of your employment with Thermo Fisher Scientific, you must successfully complete and satisfy Thermo Fisher’s pre-employment screening (including background check and drug test) and any customer-mandated screening, credentialing, or badging requirements. Customer requirements may differ from or exceed Thermo Fisher’s criteria.

Benefits

We offer comprehensive healthcare, paid Holidays, tuition reimbursement, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Accessibility/Disability Access

Job Seekers with a Disability: Thermo Fisher Scientific offers accessibility service for job seekers requiring accommodations in the job application process. For example, this may include individuals requiring assistance because of hearing, vision, mobility, or cognitive impairments. If you are a job seeker with a disability, or assisting a person with a disability, and require accessibility assistance or an accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, please submit a request by telephone at 1-855-471-2255*. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.

*This telephone line is reserved solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes, such as not being able to get into the career website, following up on an application, or other non-disability related technical issues will not receive a response.

The estimated annualized pay range for this position in British Columbia is $41,200.00–$61,750.00.

title: Registered Client Service Associate
description:
About Our Company


We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world.

Job Description

Do you have financial planning experience and want to advance your career with an industry-leading firm? Ameriprise Financial is America’s leader in financial planning and ranked #1 in customer loyalty. As a Registered Client Service Associate, you will provide dedicated support to a high producing advisors by preparing portfolio materials for client meetings, leverage your analytical skills to build financial plans, and manage client interactions to retain and develop deeper relationships. At Ameriprise Financial, we take pride in providing our clients with a personalized experience every step of the way; if you thrive in an environment where you can help others and create a positive impact on a client’s overall experience, we invite you to take your career to the next level by applying to join our team today!

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist advisor in servicing clients including preparing financial plans, conducting investment research and completing trades and transactions.
  • Prepare and summarize client meetings by scheduling and confirming meetings, enter data into contact manager, build the agenda and summary of meetings, escort clients to advisor and provide vital follow-up.
  • Prepare and ensure new business paperwork successfully submitted which includes preparing forms, obtain appropriate signatures, prepare documentation to send to home office, track new insurance applications and coordinate rollovers.
  • Prepare for and coordinate marketing events which includes crafting marketing compliance documentation and managing event marketing reimbursement.
  • Provide general administrative duties such as answering the advisors phone, processing expense management reports, prepare routine client correspondence, support for closes, set up of client files, copy and new business correspondence and alerts.

  • 3 - 5 years Relevant Experience Required

  • Detail orientated, strong math, and analytical skills. Good organization and time management skills.

We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. title: Software Engineer I, Network
description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

The Cloud Network team at Crusoe is looking for a Software Engineer I to join our team building and operating cloud network infrastructure. This is a great opportunity for an early-career engineer to grow their skills in distributed systems and network engineering while contributing to high-performance, scalable, and reliable network solutions. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, learning cloud network primitives and network engineering concepts as you take on increasingly independent ownership of features and projects.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Contribute to Engineering Efforts: Work with your team on cloud network features, helping to implement well-scoped pieces of larger projects as defined by product and engineering leads.

  • Software Development: Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to design documentation for the features you work on. Participate in testing and rollout of software across the stack, from bare metal to user-facing APIs.

  • Technical Contribution: Take part in code reviews (both giving and receiving feedback), and participate in architecture and design discussions to build your understanding of the broader system.

  • Continuous Learning: Actively grow your technical skills through mentorship, pairing, and collaboration with teammates. Ask questions, seek feedback, and build foundational knowledge in distributed network systems.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in team initiatives like tech talks, open source exploration, and book clubs to broaden your exposure to the engineering organization.

What You'll Bring to the Team

  • Foundational Technical Skills: Some hands-on experience (through internships, school projects, or ~1 year of professional work) with building or operating software systems; exposure to cloud infrastructure or distributed systems is a plus but not required.

  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Familiarity with core software engineering practices — coding standards, code reviews, source control (e.g., Git), testing, and basic CI/CD or build processes. Eagerness to learn and adopt team best practices.

  • Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java or Go. Basic understanding of Linux fundamentals and computer architecture concepts (willingness to deepen this knowledge on the job).

  • Communication & Collaboration: Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset; comfortable asking questions and working closely with more senior engineers.

  • Growth Mindset: Strong desire to learn network systems and distributed computing concepts, with a track record of picking up new technical skills quickly (coursework, personal projects, or prior roles).

Bonus Points

  • Coursework, personal projects, or internship experience involving network technologies or distributed systems.

  • Exposure to networking protocols and technologies such as BGP, VXLAN, TCP/IP, or Open vSwitch (OVS).

  • Any contributions to open source projects (school-related or personal).

  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (physical or software-defined).

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

  • Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

  • Daily meals allowance

  • Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $117,000 - $138,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Purpose:

The Business Systems Analyst applies systems analysis techniques and procedures to Floor & Decor’s Oracle enterprise application portfolio, consulting directly with business users to determine functional specifications and translating stated business needs into system requirements the development team can build without further interpretation.

This role owns requirement quality end to end — analyzing current-state processes and system configuration, decomposing complex cross-functional needs into testable requirements, and exercising independent judgment on how a business need should be structured as a solution. The role operates as an embedded analytical member of an Agile Scrum team and serves stakeholders across Finance, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Store Operations, and Human Resources. Success is measured by the accuracy and completeness of requirements at the point of development handoff, a measurable reduction in rework and defects traceable to requirement gaps, and the credibility the role earns as the authoritative translator between business intent and system capability.

Minimum Eligibility Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; directly applicable experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in a business systems analyst, systems analyst, functional analyst, or comparable role in which the primary duty was analyzing business needs and determining system functional specifications.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply structured systems analysis techniques, including current-state process analysis, gap analysis, process and data-flow mapping, and requirement decomposition.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring functional requirements, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria that development teams have built from without material rework.
  • Working proficiency with JIRA, or a comparable backlog management tool, and Confluence, or a comparable documentation platform.
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery and the analyst’s specific accountabilities within refinement, sprint planning, sprint review, and retrospective.
  • Experience planning or executing user acceptance testing, including test case authoring and defect triage.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significance — determining requirement sufficiency, assessing business impact, and making solution recommendations to product and business leadership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to translate fluently between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a process-diagramming tool such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or comparable.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle enterprise applications — Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle Retail, Oracle E-Business Suite, or comparable Oracle modules.
  • Experience in retail, multi-unit, or omnichannel operations, with exposure to merchandising, supply chain, store operations, or finance business processes.
  • Ability to write and interpret basic SQL or PL/SQL queries for independent data validation and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience supporting an enterprise application through a major implementation, upgrade, or continuous-release cycle.
  • Working understanding of integration concepts — APIs, file-based interfaces, middleware — and their implications for requirement design.
  • Exposure to reporting and analytics tooling such as Oracle Business Intelligence, Power BI, or Tableau for building or validating operational reporting requirements.
  • IIBA certification (ECBA or CCBA), or Scrum Alliance CSM/CSPO or Scrum.org PSM/PSPO certification.

Essential Job Functions:

Systems Analysis & Functional Specification

  • Apply structured systems analysis techniques to evaluate current-state Oracle application configuration, data flows, and integrations, and determine how a business requirement can be satisfied within existing system capability.
  • Consult directly with business users and process owners to determine functional specifications for application enhancements, configuration changes, and new capability.
  • Analyze and decompose complex, cross-functional business processes into structured functional requirements, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Determine whether a stated business request is best resolved through configuration, development, process change, or no change at all, and make the supporting recommendation to the Product Manager.
  • Produce and maintain process maps, data-flow documentation, and requirement traceability for the applications in scope, so that design decisions and their rationale are auditable.

Backlog Ownership & Agile Delivery

  • Own the analytical quality of the product backlog — decomposing epics, refining stories, resolving ambiguity, and determining whether an item is sufficiently defined to enter a sprint.
  • Lead story refinement and requirement review sessions with developers, QA, and business stakeholders to reach documented agreement on scope and definition of done.
  • Assess incoming requests, defects, and enhancement demand; determine root cause and business impact; and recommend relative sequencing to the Product Manager.
  • Represent business intent in sprint ceremonies, resolving requirement questions in real time so that delivery is not blocked on interpretation.
  • Evaluate delivered functionality against the original specification and determine whether acceptance criteria have been satisfied.

Testing & Solution Validation

  • Design test scenarios and test cases derived from functional specifications and determine whether test coverage is adequate for the risk of the change being released.
  • Plan and lead user acceptance testing — identifying and preparing business testers, coordinating execution, and determining whether identified defects are release-blocking.
  • Diagnose reported system issues by isolating requirement, configuration, data, and code causes, and route each with a documented analysis rather than a restatement of the symptom.
  • Validate that released changes produce the intended business outcome and recommend follow-on work where they do not.

Business Partnership & Process Improvement

  • Build trusted advisory relationships with business stakeholders, developers, QA, and other analysts across the enterprise application portfolio.
  • Identify process gaps, control weaknesses, manual workarounds, and inefficiencies; quantify their operational or financial impact; and propose system or process remedies.
  • Advise business partners on opportunities to adopt standard application functionality in place of custom development and articulate the total-cost implications of each path.
  • Translate system changes into audience-appropriate impact summaries, training content, and release communications that support business readiness and adoption.

Working Conditions (travel & environment)

  • Occasional travel may be required – up to 25%
  • Ability to interact with store, warehouse, and commercial teams as needed

PHYSICAL/SENSORY REQUIREMENTS

Medium Work – Ability to exert 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10-25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. The employee is often required to use their hands and fingers, to handle or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

title: Logistics Representative 1
description:
States considered: Missouri

Role Description

This position is responsible for various tasks relating to the receipt, storage, order fulfillment and shipping of customer orders.

  • Preparation of orders for shipment in a customer-friendly manner. This may include the accurate checking of each carton and the packing of material into boxes containers and pallets assuring the appropriate protection of our products and shipment modes are used to assure they are received by our customers according to our standards of care meeting our product and customer requirements.
  • Consistently follow SOPs and standards of ca/re to meet all product and customer requirements.

  • Daily operation of MHE
  • Perform stock/module replenishments.

  • Forklift training on the sit down/stand up forklift is required; 2 years' experience is preferred. Certification is preferred.

  • Ability to work in warm and/or refrigerated environments.
  • Demonstrated qualities of hard work, teamwork, and commitment to excellence are essential.

Qualifications:

A high school diploma or equivalent is required, plus work experience in general warehousing/logistics (to include order assembly, shipping/receiving, stocking, inventory maintenance, picking/verification functions, and forklift) is also required. 2 years' experience is preferred.

Physical Requirements:

The work environment is a standard indoor industrial setting, and may include warehousing, manufacturing, maintenance and/or production areas. The coolest temperature will be 36F to 46F. Routine lifting up to 40 lbs. and occasionally up to 80 lbs. is required, and incumbent must be able to access all areas of the facility. Personal protective equipment, such as ear plugs, safety shoes, safety glasses, protective clothing and/or headwear must be worn, as required.

title: Global Communications & Community Director, Digital & Data
description:
Job Description:

Our IMO Digital & Data organization sits at the center of one of the largest and most complex integrations in history: bringing together two global businesses to create the future of Mars Snacking. This is where strategy becomes reality. From modernizing core capabilities and unlocking the value of data to accelerating the adoption of AI, our teams are shaping how work gets done across the organization. Every role within our team offers the opportunity to solve meaningful challenges and leave a lasting mark on a business that reaches consumers around the world.

As the Global Communications & Community Director, Digital & Data, you will create the strategy, design, and delivery of digital adoption, learning, and AI-enabled enablement experiences across the organization. This role is responsible for building a modern ecosystem that helps associates successfully adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working while accelerating business value across the Mars Snacking integration.

You will lead efforts to ensure that every system cutover, master data change, and process transition lands smoothly, not only for our internal Associates but also for our external partners, including customers, suppliers, financial institutions, and distributors.

This is a temporary assignment through December 2028, Preference is for this person to be located in the Global Innovation Center but we will consider remote candidates.

What are we looking for?

  • A senior, hands-on communications leader with strong business program management capability.
  • Proven experience in leading functional communications for large-scale integration and transformation programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage communications for a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Expertise in embedded organizational change leadership to ensure solutions are operationally adopted.
  • Ability to navigate regional nuances and potential legal/consultation obligations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, collaboration platforms (e.g., SharePoint), and emerging AI tools
  • Self-driven, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Lead the development, execution, and deployment of functional communications for the IMO program, spanning people, process, technology, and data.
  • Manage communications for both internal audiences (Associates, Line Managers, leadership) and external audiences (customers, suppliers, partners).
  • Build and scale our "Champion Communities" - networks of Associates embedded in functions and regions who translate program messaging into local reality, model new ways of working, and drive momentum.
  • Leverage digital adoption platforms, learning technologies, AI capabilities, and knowledge management to create scalable solutions that help associates learn and perform directly in the flow of work.
  • Serve as a senior, hands-on delivery communications leader with strong program management capability to ensure integration communications are deployed and solutions are operationally adopted.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with over 130,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Software Engineer
description:
What You Will Do:

At Independent Software, as a Software Engineer, you will design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications supporting mission-critical systems. You will work with Java, Angular, RESTful APIs, relational databases, containerization, and Kubernetes while supporting application and database modernization initiatives.

You will participate throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and operational support. This role also provides opportunities to work across application, database, and deployment technologies in both cloud and on-premises environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze user and system requirements to design, develop, test, and maintain Java and Angular applications
  • Design, develop, and support RESTful APIs, service integrations, and data access components
  • Develop and support solutions using Oracle, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, and other relational database technologies
  • Support application modernization, including Spring Boot migrations, microservices, database modernization, and containerization
  • Deploy and support containerized applications in Kubernetes environments across cloud and on-premises infrastructure
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous process improvement
  • Develop automated unit and integration tests and support CI/CD pipelines
  • Maintain technical and development documentation using Jira and Confluence
  • Provide backup database administration support for Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB
  • Cross-train across application, database, and deployment technologies to support operational continuity

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Professional Software Engineering experience developing and supporting enterprise applications
  • Experience with Java and/or other object-oriented application development technologies
  • Experience developing or supporting web applications and backend services
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, or similar technologies
  • Experience with application modernization, containerization, or modern application deployment practices
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD processes
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional engineering teams

Desired Skills:
  • Experience developing enterprise Java applications using Spring Boot or similar frameworks
  • Experience developing Angular or comparable front-end applications
  • Experience with microservices and application or database modernization
  • Experience deploying and supporting applications using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes technologies such as Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress, Persistent Volumes, and Helm
  • Experience with cloud-based Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, OpenShift, Rancher, or similar technologies
  • Experience implementing GitLab CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevSecOps practices
  • Experience providing operational or backup database administration support
  • Experience with XML, JSON, or other structured data formats
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence in Agile development environments

Education and Experience:

Level 1
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university plus twelve (12) years of relevant Software Engineering experience supporting programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity; OR
  • Sixteen (16) years of relevant Software Engineering experience may be substituted for the Bachelor’s degree.

Level 2
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university plus fourteen (14) years of relevant Software Engineering experience supporting programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity; OR
  • Eighteen (18) years of relevant Software Engineering experience supporting projects with similar software processes may be substituted for the Bachelor’s degree.

Clearance Requirement:
  • Must possess an active TS SCI with appropriate Polygraph to be considered for this role


Why Choose Independent Software:

At Independent Software, our people are the mission. We’ve built a company around collaboration, integrity, and innovation and we make sure our team has the tools and support to grow, succeed, and thrive.

When you join us, you will:
  • Support critical national security missions that matter
  • Be part of a close-knit, employee-first culture where your voice is heard
  • Expand your skills through ongoing training, mentorship, and career development
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, generous benefits, and work-life balance


Ready to take the next step in your career? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Apply today.

title: Apprentice Engineer
description:
Transwestern is a vertically integrated commercial real estate firm dedicated to serving investors, partners and clients through expertise in investment, development, brokerage and property management. Our experience spans diverse property types, including logistics, multifamily, retail, mixed-use, healthcare, office, data centers, hotel, and life sciences. POSITION SUMMARY:

The Apprentice Building Engineer is responsible for completing work orders, grounds maintenance, painting, caulking, HVAC, plumbing, drywall, electrical and completing maintenance on buildings as needed. Under the supervision of the Chief Engineer, the Assistant Engineer will perform general preventive maintenance and corrective repair of buildings, industrial systems, equipment, and grounds.

  • Assist with troubleshooting and repairs of buildings and installed systems to include, but not limited to plumbing systems, kitchen equipment, roofs, drains and HVAC.

  • Perform general preventive maintenance and corrective repair of buildings, industrial systems, equipment, and grounds.

  • Maintain all equipment as required per preventive maintenance programs.

  • Inspect building systems including fire alarms, HVAC, and plumbing to ensure operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieves environmental conditions prescribed by client.

  • Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning additional assistance as needed.

  • Maintain an energy management program to ensure measures are taken to operate all systems in the most efficient manner to keep operating costs at a minimum.

  • Maintain the building lighting system, including element and ballast repairs or replacements.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and a minimum of two years of related experience and/or trade school training or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • A minimum of 2 years building maintenance experience.

  • Thorough knowledge in all building systems operations, maintenance and repair.

  • Universal CFC certification preferred or working toward CFC certification and/or local or state license in mechanical or HVAC trade. Valid Driver License (may be required).

  • Knowledgeable in energy management systems, techniques, and operations.

  • Basic skills with Microsoft Office Outlook, Word, and Excel.

  • Must have a thorough understanding of HVAC, electrical and building automation systems.

  • Ability to understand and give general instructions in standard situations.

  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.

  • Strong customer service orientation.

  • May require shift work, overtime and/or on call duties.

  • Stooping, standing, climbing and frequent lifting of a minimum of 50 lbs. of equipment (pump, tools, ladders) and ability to safely install rigging/lifting device.

  • May be required to work extended periods of time without relief when responding to priority/emergency situations (including overtime type assignments).

  • Climb ladders and stairs.

WORK SHIFT:

First Shift (United States of America)

LOCATION:

Houston, TX

This is a dynamic, on-site role that places you at the heart of the action. As a result, an essential function of this position is working on-site. Remote or hybrid options are not available. Being on property allows you to build strong relationships with clients and tenants, respond in real time, and make a visible impact every day.



ABOUT US

Our firm is built on a shared purpose: Empowering good people to do extraordinary things together. We hire smart, passionate, hard-working people who value both collaboration and independence. United by our brand promise, we own the outcome for clients, investors and partners. Learn more at transwestern.com.

All candidates selected for an offer of employment are subject to pre-employment background checks, which may include criminal history, education verification, motor vehicle records, credit history, and professional license verification. In addition, your employment with Transwestern is subject to successfully passing a drug screen check prior to you starting with the firm.

title: Senior Production Controller

title: Product Design Intern
description:
Plasiv is building an AI digital solution that helps manufacturing teams plan, study, balance, and improve production lines. We’re replacing fragmented tools, spreadsheets, and legacy software with one connected system built for how modern teams actually work.

Our products are used to make complex, high-stakes operational decisions. That means the design problems are rarely simple, but the experience should be.

We’re looking for a Product Design Intern to help us make that happen.

Role Overview

You’ll work at the intersection of product design, AI interaction design, and rapid prototyping, helping shape complex product experiences from early ideas through implementation.

You’ll work directly with our designer, founder, and engineers. You’ll contribute to core areas of the product, explore new AI interactions, improve our design system, and help turn ambiguous problems into clear, polished experiences.

The ideal candidate is curious, hands-on, comfortable with code, and excited by complex software. You should be able to take a product problem, understand the system around it, reason through the UX, and quickly make something the team can react to.

This is a high-impact internship for someone who wants genuine influence over what we build, how it works, and how it feels. You won’t be doing busywork, and your work won’t disappear into a concept folder. You’ll help design things that ship.

What You’ll Do

  • Design polished product experiences across core areas of the Plasiv platform.

  • Contribute to features end-to-end, from research and workflow mapping to prototyping, high-fidelity design, implementation, and iteration.

  • Explore AI-native interactions involving recommendations, automation, explainability, system feedback, and human control.

  • Work closely with the founding product designer, founders, and engineers from the earliest product conversations, not downstream of them.

  • Use prototypes to think, communicate, test ideas, and move product decisions forward.

  • Contribute to our design system, component library, visual language, and reusable interaction patterns.

  • Learn from real customer usage and continue improving experiences after they ship.

What You Bring

  • You’re currently pursuing or have recently completed a degree in Product Design, HCI, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • A strong portfolio that shows how you solve difficult UX problems, not only your final screens.

  • Strong interaction and visual design skills, with proficiency in Figma.

  • Experience working with design systems, reusable components, variants, and component-based product thinking.

  • Comfort with code and an understanding of how digital products are built. You don’t need to be a front-end engineer, but code shouldn’t feel like a mysterious black box.

  • Clear communication and a willingness to share early, receive feedback, and keep improving.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Tailwind, or similar frontend technologies.

  • Previous experience at a startup or on a small, fast-moving product team.

  • An AI product, technical platform, developer tool, or complex systems project in your portfolio.

  • Experience prototyping with tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or other AI-assisted building tools.

  • Skills in motion design, data visualization, information architecture, or user research.

Internship Details

  • Duration: Three months

  • Location: San Jose, California

  • Work arrangement: In-person is strongly preferred

  • Potential: There may be opportunities to continue working with Plasiv depending on performance and mutual fit

How We Work

Speed matters at Plasiv because learning matters.

We share work early, test ideas quickly, and improve them as we learn. We care deeply about quality, but we don’t wait for perfect conditions before making progress.

Design, engineering, and product decisions happen together. You’ll be part of the conversations where the product is shaped, working alongside the people building it and the founders setting its direction.

You won’t always receive a neat brief with every answer included. Sometimes you’ll start with a customer problem, a rough idea, or a workflow no one has fully untangled yet. Your job is to ask good questions, make the problem visible, explore possibilities, and help the team find the right answer through making.

We’re ambitious, direct, collaborative, and serious about the work without taking ourselves too seriously.

Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Senior Algorithm and Machine Learning engineer!

As part of Beacon's analytics and machine learning domain, you'll work alongside fellow data scientists, neuroscientists, engineers, and clinicians to scope, build, deploy, and maintain the machine and deep learning models that analyze brain and biosignal data for advancing sleep, neurological, and psychiatric therapy development.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those who lead by example. As such, we're always seeking out new contributors whose work demonstrates innate curiosity, a bias toward simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and—most of all—a deep empathy toward colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Beacon's work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs in Boston, New York City and Paris. This is a fully remote role based anywhere in the U.S.

What success looks like

  • Participate in and lead the entire biosignal-based algorithm development lifecycle for medical devices including specifications and requirements gathering, data curation and labeling, development, failure-analysis, production, maintenance, and documentation.
  • Select, implement, and develop the most appropriate method for each problem, knowing when to apply deep learning techniques and when other methods are more effective.
  • Enhance our internal deep learning and machine learning tools to boost team efficiency, introduce new model architectures and algorithmic techniques, and refine the codebase to encourage reusability where needed to enable rapid experimentation.
  • Spread and improve our best practices to ensure algorithm implementations are user-friendly, well-documented, and thoroughly tested, including unit tests, comprehensive documentation, CI, and non-regression testing.
  • Present results to key stakeholders and assist them in utilizing algorithms for client engagement.
  • Support the client-facing projects to understand and shape the impact Beacon algorithms have for our customers, both for existing deployed algorithms, and future algorithm development.

What you will bring

  • You have more than 5 years of industry experience in machine learning and deep learning, particularly in health sciences or other regulated fields, with a proven track record of bringing algorithms into production.
  • You are experienced with digital signal processing (DSP) and statistics and care about using the right tool for the job, which in many cases might not be machine learning or deep learning.
  • You are proficient in using PyTorch (preferred) or other deep learning frameworks for training, developing, and deploying deep learning models.
  • You are proficient with latest Deep Learning advances (Transformer/ViT, large scale modeling, large model training, ...)
  • You follow and spread best practices in software and ML engineering, including testing, version control, code reviews, documentation, Dockerization, CI/CD, and experiment tracking.
  • You are experienced with biosignals, medical imaging data, or large time-series datasets, or are enthusiastic about learning more in the domain.
  • You thrive in a team environment, recognizing that collaboration, open communication, and continuous feedback are essential for collective success.
  • You are able to distill, discuss, and present complex technical topics in a way that is appropriate for the audience at hand, both internally and externally.
  • You are excited to participate in the entire algorithm development lifecycle, which spans scoping, data wrangling, algorithm development/experimentation, formal validation, quality/regulatory documentation, production deployment, and working with clients who might benefit from these algorithms.

title: Telesales Executive - Outbound

Telesales Executive (Outbound)

Dubai, UAE · Full-time, on-site

Turn every call into a booked service.

We’re looking for a telesales professional who’s confident on the phone, sharp on objections, and driven by targets — someone who can pick up a warm lead and turn it into a booked service before the call ends.

The Role

You’ll spend your day on the phone with prospective and existing customers — making outbound sales calls, handling inbound enquiries, and converting both into paying customers. You’ll pitch our services, handle objections, close on the call, and keep your pipeline clean in the CRM. You’ll work from the Dubai office, six days a week, as part of the telesales team.

This is a target-driven sales role. We expect you to close on the call, not just log the lead.

What You’ll Do

  • Make outbound sales calls and handle inbound enquiries to convert leads into paying customers.
  • Pitch Justlife’s services confidently, matching the right package to each customer’s needs.
  • Handle objections, negotiate, and close on the call.
  • Log every interaction accurately in the CRM and keep your pipeline clean and up to date.
  • Follow up consistently on warm leads, and re-engage lapsed customers.
  • Hit and exceed your monthly sales targets.

What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 3+ years of sales calling experience with a B2C company.
  • Currently based in Dubai — this is an in-office role, with no remote option.
  • English proficiency at B2 (Upper-Intermediate) or above — clear, confident spoken English.
  • Comfortable operating a CRM system day to day.
  • Resilient and target-driven, and comfortable with high call volumes.
  • Available to work 6 days a week, on-site in Dubai.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling consumer or home services.
  • Additional languages spoken by our customers in the UAE — for example Tagalog, Arabic, Hindi, or Urdu.
  • A track record of consistently beating monthly targets.

What We Offer

  • Fair compensation with a fixed monthly salary plus a performance incentive.
  • Full training on our services and sales process before you start selling.
  • Working setup: Dubai, UAE — in-office, full-time, 6 days a week.
  • Employment and visa sponsorship handled through the Justlife Partner entity.

Interview Process

  1. CV screening.
  2. Initial communication round (30 minutes).
  3. Mock sales call (30 minutes). We’ll share the service background and key features in advance so you can prepare. A member of our BD team then runs a live mock call with situational questions and real scenarios.
  4. BD Head round (30 minutes).

Why Justlife, Why Now

We started in 2015 by digitalising home cleaning in the UAE. Today we operate across 10+ cities, with 200+ full-time employees, 6000+ service professionals, and over 15 million sessions delivered. We’re a scaling tech company with the ambition to build the most loved super app for home services in the region.

Every booking starts with someone deciding to try us. On this team, that someone is often you.

We read every application. We respond within 7 business days.
