title: Contract Management Specialist (Hybrid) - Dallas, TX
description:
Integrative Emergency Services, LLC ("IES") is looking for a Contract Management Specialist who will be part of a team responsible for the day-to-day management of clinician contracting for the company. This role manages a high volume of employment and independent contractor agreements for Physicians, APPs, CRNAs, and other clinicians, from initial request through review, approval, and execution. The position ensures contracts are accurate, timely, aligned with established standards, and completed within established service level expectations, while supporting effective contract lifecycle management through the ongoing maintenance and enhancement of contracting tools, templates, and workflows. Work format is hybrid and based at the Corporate office at 4835 LBJ Fwy, Dallas, TX, 75244.

As an integrated vendor and partner to health systems, IES is dedicated to cultivating best practices in emergency care, providing comprehensive acute care services, creating value, and supporting patients, employees, client providers, and physicians in pursuit of the highest quality healthcare.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
The responsibilities listed here represent the majority of the role but are not all-inclusive; other duties may be assigned.

  • Draft a high volume of Employment and Independent Contractor Agreements for Physicians, APPs, CRNAs, and other clinicians, as well as amendments, exhibits, addenda, and other related documents, using standard templates and approved business terms.
  • Review contracts and requested changes for accuracy and alignment with established company standards, coordinating non-standard terms or revised language with Legal Counsel.
  • Create, update, and maintain contract management system(s), including workspaces, contract status, records, and required documentation.
  • Manage the contracting process from initial request through review, approval, and execution, including coordinating signatures and following up on outstanding items, resolving contracting questions, facilitating approvals, and escalating non-standard terms or issues as appropriate, while ensuring contracts are completed within established service level expectations.
  • Track renewals, amendments, terminations, and other required contract actions and maintain complete and accurate contract records, including filing, uploading, and archiving executed agreements and related documentation.
  • Prepare termination letters in accordance with guidance provided by Human Resources and/or Legal Counsel and maintain related templates to support consistent and accurate processing.
  • Provide guidance to internal stakeholders regarding contract processes, status, and established contract terms.
  • Conduct contract audits and reviews to identify missing documentation, inconsistencies, outdated information, or other items requiring follow-up.
  • Manage and continuously improve contract lifecycle management processes, including maintaining and enhancing contracting tools, templates, and workflows, while ensuring compliance with due diligence, approval, and contract execution policies and procedures.

  • High level of attention to detail and ability to work methodically and consistently through contracts.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong customer service orientation.

Preferred:

title: Data engineer mmh260519-5
description:
Insurance Domain Experience Strongly Preferred, Especially Where Data Impacts

Premium processing.

Role Purpose

The Data Engineer – Data Acquisition at Guardrisk is a hands-on integration and data enablement role responsible for ensuring that external data providers (cells, binder holders, system providers, administrators, and partners) deliver complete, accurate, timely, and technically compliant data that Guardrisk can reliably ingest and process. The role exists to design, implement, and operationalise external data ingestion pipelines , with a primary focus on premium bordereaux (BDX) , and secondary responsibility for master and transactional data exchanged with third parties. This role works directly with external parties , engaging them on data structures, formats, validation rules, delivery mechanisms, and remediation of issues. It partners closely with the Data Architect (to align to target architecture and data models), Data Analysts (to ensure analytical usability), and Data Stewards (to ensure operational data quality once data is live). The role is delivery-oriented and externally facing, bridging business requirements, technical standards, and partner capabilities to ensure Guardrisk can confidently process and rely on third-party data. Requirements Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.

Strong emphasis on practical data engineering experience over theoretical qualifications.

5+ years’ experience as a data engineer , with demonstrable focus on: External data ingestion and integration. File- and API-based data exchange. Data validation and reconciliation. Strong Experience Working With

Bordereaux or high-volume transactional data.

Financial or insurance datasets.

Proven experience engaging directly with external data providers .

Solid exposure to Microsoft Azure data technologies (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, SQL).

Insurance Domain Experience Strongly Preferred, Especially Where Data Impacts

Premium processing.

Finance.

Reporting and regulatory submissions.

External Data Acquisition & Integration (Primary Accountability) Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for external data sources, with a primary focus on: Premium bordereaux (BDX) Policy and transactional feeds Supporting master data where required Implement ingestion patterns aligned to Guardrisk’s data architecture (batch, file-based, API, secure transfer). Ensure external data conforms to agreed: Data models Schemas Validation and reconciliation rules Delivery frequency and cut-offs Enable scalable and repeatable onboarding of new external data providers. External Partner Engagement & Enablement Act as the technical data interface between Guardrisk and external providers. Engage directly with: Cells Binder holders Administrators System providers Support partners by: Explaining Guardrisk data requirements and standards Assisting with mapping, formatting, and transformation logic Advising on delivery mechanisms and error handling Drive remediation where partner data does not meet required standards. Travel to partner and provide onsite support. Premium BDX Enablement & Control Implement robust ingestion and validation of premium bordereaux, including: Structural validation Completeness checks Reconciliation against expected volumes and values Ensure BDX data is fit for: Finance and premium recognition Underwriting performance analysis Regulatory and internal reporting Work with Data Analysts and Finance to resolve discrepancies early in the pipeline. Data Quality & Issue Resolution (Engineering Perspective) Build and Support automated validation and control checks into ingestion pipelines. Support the Data Validator and the rollout in the external data provider space. Partner with Data Stewards when operational data quality issues are detected. Perform root cause analysis across: Source systems Partner delivery processes Ingestion and transformation logic Implement durable fixes rather than manual workarounds. title: Agency Budget Analyst I-III
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY

Provide business planning and risk support to designated management groups for a broad range of financial and business issues with a moderate level of independence. Respond to budgetary and financial challenges while being proactive to addressing business needs. Partners with Project Controls, Finance, and Project Management to review, challenge, and validate project financial performance, while maintaining independence from day-to-day project execution.


IDEAL CANDIDATE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

An ideal candidate for this position would possess strong technical accounting expertise, with a deep understanding of complex cost accounting methodologies and the ability to apply these principles to real-world business scenarios. They would have a strong background with financial analysis and control of activities in support of corporate programs such as staffing, benefits, allocations, budget change management, forecasting and cost trends. They should also have substantial experience working with advanced Excel functionality, including the ability to manage large datasets, create complex financial models, and analyze variances effectively. Proficiency in WorkDay Financials and Adaptive Planning software is also desired. Experience with project management also a plus.

In addition to technical proficiency, the ideal candidate would demonstrate excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, enabling them to clearly present complex financial information to diverse audiences, from department managers to senior leadership. They should be detail-oriented, ensuring all financial reporting is accurate, thorough, and aligns with industry standards, GAAP, and contractual requirements.

They should be able to independently develop, coordinate, and execute business and financial controls, particularly in budget development and monitoring, while proactively identifying and addressing risks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are essential, as the candidate will need to analyze cost performance, recommend corrective actions, and ensure sound business and financial practices are followed. Their ability to collaborate effectively across the organization will be crucial for success in this role.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

Responsible for development, coordination, tracking and execution, to include:

  • Support Corporate budget development and budget change management, staffing control and reporting, and senior management financial reporting.

  • Perform independent review and challenge of project Latest Revised Estimates (LREs), with a focus on fiscal year-end projections.

  • Evaluate reasonableness of cost forecasts, assumptions, and trends and provide recommendations to improve forecast accuracy and transparency

  • Develop and monitor organizational cost performance vs. budget by analyzing variances and cost trends, and developing recommendations for corrective actions. Provide monthly financial summaries to supported managers and projects.

  • Ensure key risks related to these activities have been identified and compensating internal controls are in place and institutionalized.

  • Create reports for internal teams and/or external clients

  • Use graphs, infographics and other methods to visualize data

  • Understanding of Change Management process

  • Intrapersonal/Interpersonal proactive collaboration within department and external customers


Perform special assignments using knowledge gained through experience and education. Conduct benchmarking studies for business-related issues.

Must participate on the Emergency Response team (ERO) when designated.

Business Financial Planning and Risk Analyst III

  • Upon completion of performance data, update investor communication documents and templates for review by supervising team members.

title: MASTER SCHEDULER
description:
Littelfuse (NASDAQ: LFUS) is a diversified industrial technology manufacturing company shaping solutions for the safe and efficient transfer of electrical energy. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, USA, we serve customers across industrial, transportation, and electronics markets worldwide. With approximately 16,000 employees we design and manufacture innovative technologies that support electrification, energy efficiency, and advanced automation. Our global reach is matched by a culture that empowers innovation and long-term growth. Guided by our principles We Care, We Succeed With Our Customers, and We Own the Outcome, we work collaboratively, think boldly, and deliver solutions that move industries forward.

Reporting directly to the Planning Manager, you as a Master Scheduler will be responsible for managing and coordinating the production planning and scheduling process to ensure the availability of materials, production capacity, and demand information required to meet customer delivery commitments. You will optimize inventory levels, resource utilization, and operational performance while working closely with Manufacturing, Purchasing, Materials, Engineering, Logistics, and Customer Service.

You will develop and maintain short-, medium-, and long-term production plans, determine production priorities and sequencing, monitor planning and supply chain KPIs, and proactively identify and resolve material and capacity risks. In this role, you will also lead and develop the Planning team, drive continuous improvement initiatives, improve plan accuracy and commitment-date reliability, and participate in ERP, MRP, and planning system implementations and improvements.

About the Job:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute short-, medium-, and long-term production plans based on customer demand, material availability, production capacity, and operational priorities.

  • Manage the master production schedule to ensure production priorities and sequencing support customer delivery commitments.

  • Coordinate with Manufacturing, Materials, Purchasing, Engineering, Logistics, and Customer Service to align production plans and resolve constraints.

  • Monitor material availability and proactively identify supply risks that could impact production continuity or customer deliveries.

  • Partner with Purchasing and Materials teams to resolve material shortages, supply constraints, and other risks affecting production.

  • Manage and optimize WIP and Finished Goods inventory levels in alignment with business and customer requirements.

  • Analyze production capacity and resource availability to identify constraints and develop mitigation plans.

  • Support demand and capacity management through MPS, MRP, and S&OP/SIOP processes.

  • Improve production plan accuracy and the reliability of customer commitment dates.

  • Monitor and report Planning and Supply Chain KPIs, identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives focused on planning effectiveness, inventory optimization, capacity utilization, and operational performance.

  • Participate in ERP, MRP, and production planning system implementations, upgrades, and process improvements.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Planning team by establishing objectives, performance metrics, and individual development plans.

  • Coordinate cross-functional escalations, both internal and external, related to production planning, materials, capacity, and customer commitments.

  • Use data and analytical tools to support decision-making and develop effective solutions to planning and supply chain challenges.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between demand, production, materials, capacity, and customer requirements.

  • Exercise authority to stop any process or activity that does not comply with applicable quality, safety, health, environmental, or ethical requirements.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Location: Matehuala, San Luis Potosí.

About You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Manufacturing Engineering, Logistics, or a related field.

  • Experience in manufacturing environments, preferably in discrete manufacturing, electronics, electrical, automotive, or industrial industries.

  • Experience with Master Production Scheduling (MPS), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and S&OP/SIOP processes.

  • Strong experience in production planning, scheduling, and capacity management.

  • Experience managing materials, inventory levels, WIP, and Finished Goods.

  • Experience working with ERP/MRP systems and participating in system implementations or process improvements.

  • Experience leading or developing a Planning team, including setting objectives, metrics, and development plans.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

  • Strong understanding of production planning, supply chain, capacity, inventory, and manufacturing processes.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively collaborate with Manufacturing, Purchasing, Materials, Engineering, Logistics, Customer Service, and other stakeholders.

  • Strategic and tactical planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong continuous improvement mindset and ability to identify opportunities to improve planning accuracy, inventory, capacity utilization, and operational performance.

  • Conversational English required.

  • Strong escalation management and cross-functional coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and effectively manage competing priorities.

  • Results-oriented, proactive, and highly collaborative.

title: Senior Director, Advertising Operations & AI Enablement
description:
The Krazy Coupon Lady (KCL) is a female-founder-owned shopping intelligence company on a mission to give smart shoppers the advantage by turning our expertise into their indispensable shopping companion. Millions of shoppers come back to us before every purchase, and we're hiring the people who'll shape what they find and why they keep coming back. We move fast, care deeply about our audience, and believe great work happens when smart people bring clarity, creativity, and accountability to the table.


You may have noticed that our headquarters are in Boise, ID, but our workforce is fully remote in the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, or Wisconsin. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of U.S. time zones.


KCL is standing up a dedicated Advertising Operations & AI Enablement function, and this role owns it end to end: tag management, ad trafficking, and the integrity of the statistics we put in front of our clients. We need a senior leader to define the strategy and stand up the stack behind it, starting with selecting the tag management platform and the ad server KCL will standardize on. Reporting directly to the Head of Product inside the Data team, this Senior Director will partner with Data Engineering and Analytics on where event data lands, and with Sales on what KCL can credibly commit to in client contracts. Success looks like a best-in-class tag management and ad serving architecture that is governed, scalable, and able to absorb the complexity of KCL's product and marketing requirements. This work sits in an environment spanning Segment, Amplitude, Databricks, and the major ad and pixel ecosystems. We expect this leader to use AI tooling to move faster than a function this size normally could, and to extend that beyond their own remit by championing how KCL works with AI, evaluating and rolling out tooling at a company level. This is a hands-on leadership role: strategy first, with the expectation of personally executing much of it before a team is in place.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the tag management strategy. Select the tag management platform KCL will standardize on, then own site and app wide tagging architecture end to end, bringing legacy tags, floodlight activities, and orphaned pixels into a documented inventory where every tag has a named owner and a defined purpose.

  • Implement the tag management platform. Stand up the chosen system, covering data layer design, naming and versioning conventions, environment separation, and a QA and approval workflow, then train marketing, product, and engineering partners to work within it. The goal is a scalable set-up where a small team can maintain the full platform confidently.

  • Own ad trafficking and ad-server strategy. Evaluate, select, implement, and operate the ad-serving stack behind client-facing campaigns (Google Ad Manager, Freestar etc.), traffic creative and placements, and manage the technical relationship with ad-tech vendors and their reps.

  • Deliver defensible impressions reporting. Design and stand behind the external, client-facing reporting methodology so it holds up under third-party verification.

  • Keep internal and external measurement reconciled. Partner with Data Engineering and Analytics on where event data lands (Amplitude, Databricks) versus what routes through the external ad server, so the two paths agree rather than diverge.

  • Put AI to work on ops-heavy work to increase productivity. Accelerate tag reviews, QA of trafficking setups, and reporting reconciliation, then turn what works into repeatable practices others can adopt.

  • Keep KCL current with industry best practice. Bring outside-in knowledge of programmatic and display ad-serving standards, and adjust KCL's approach as the ad-tech landscape moves.

  • Represent KCL with clients and across internal stakeholders. Navigate a complex internal stakeholder network spanning Data, Sales, Partner Revenue, Engineering, and join the Sales team in front of senior executives at large CPG brands and retail partners to explain KCL's measurement approach and what we can commit to / end of campaign presentations.

  • Build the function. Begin as an individual contributor and player-coach, then hire and manage as the function's scope expands.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years in advertising operations or ad trafficking at a publisher, media company, or high-traffic consumer app, including direct ownership of a tag management platform such as Google Tag Manager or Tealium.

  • Hands-on experience operating at least one enterprise ad server (Google Ad Manager/DFP, Freestar, or equivalent), including client-facing reporting that had to withstand outside scrutiny.

  • Working fluency with the signal path into ad platforms: Meta CAPI alongside the Pixel, Google Ads enhanced conversions, and major ad platforms’ conversion APIs, with real ownership of identifier quality, event match rates, browser/server deduplication, and consent state.

  • Ability to pull data independently directly with SQL when the answer is not already in a dashboard.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to increase personal or team throughput on ops-heavy work.

  • Proven ability to manage a complex internal stakeholder network, plus the presence to meet senior client-side executives at large CPG brands and retail partners alongside Sales.

  • Comfort operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity.

  • 5+ years leading an operations team of at least 3 technical individuals. Clear experience building and growing a high-performing team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A proven track record of raising internal productivity with AI, and a willingness to champion the rollout of AI tooling to teams beyond Ad Ops.

  • Advanced SQL plus one or more additional scripting languages (e.g. Python, PySpark) for reconciliation and QA work at scale.

  • Experience leading a platform selection or migration, whether ad server or tag manager, rather than only steady-state operation of an inherited stack.

  • Experience running or contracting a formal tag inventory and cleanup project, including floodlight rationalization and pixel governance.

  • Agency background on the media or ad ops side, with direct exposure to how large advertisers structure their verification requirements.

  • Familiarity with coupon and deals, retail media, or affiliate and sponsored-content business models.

BENEFITS

At KCL, we believe in taking care of our team—both at work and beyond. Here’s a quick look at what we offer:

Base Salary: $160,000-$180,000

💻 Home Office Perks – We set you up for success with a company-provided laptop, a $450 home office stipend, and monthly reimbursements for internet and phone.

🌴 Time to Recharge – Enjoy 10 company holidays, a floating holiday, flexible PTO (or accrued PTO for select content roles), and a sabbatical every 5 years.

❤️ Health & Wellness – Choose from three insurance plans, with KCL covering 100% of medical and dental premiums (excluding the PPO buy-up). We also offer vision, life insurance, FSA, HSA contributions, fertility benefits, and an Employee Assistance Program.

💰 Financial & Retirement Benefits – A 401(k) with a 4% company match, multiple bonus opportunities, and professional development perks like certification reimbursement and public speaking bonuses.

👶 Family & Leave – Generous parental leave (12 weeks for carrying parents, 8 weeks for non-carrying), extended caregiver leave, and even time off if you're cast on Survivor!

💡 Community & Culture – Regular team check-ins, company-wide meetings, and a commitment to giving back through our KCL Foundation and service initiatives.

title: CRISIS THERAPIST
description:
Who We Are

Pawnee Mental Health is proud of the high-quality services we offer and the positive outcomes our clients achieve. Our employees are the heart of our organization, and each person contributes to our mission. We’re looking for motivated, passionate individuals who want to use their skills to support others. We believe people facing mental health or substance use challenges deserve the chance to live meaningful, productive lives. If that mission resonates with you, we encourage you to explore this role and join us in making an impact. What

What We Offer

Pawnee Mental Health, we are committed to supporting our employees’ well-being by offering a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:

  • HRSA- Health Workforce: Loan Repayment Program for Health Careers
  • Continuing Education: Pawnee provides up to 5 days of additional paid leave for continuing education and a fund of up to $1,000 annually.
  • Medical & Vision Insurance: Accessible plans to support your health needs offered through BCBS or Aetna.
  • Dental Insurance: 100% covered by Pawnee for employees.
  • Kansas Public Employee Retirement System (KPERS): Secure your future with KPERS retirement benefits, a lifetime pension program.
  • Life Insurance: coverage up to 150% of your annual income and long-term disability insurance at no cost.
  • Paid Holidays: Enjoy 8 paid holidays throughout the year.
  • Generous PTO: Start earning 8 hours of PTO per month—equivalent to 12 days per year—with an increase to 24 days per year after your first anniversary.
  • Paid Medical Leave: Receive a 40-hour bank of paid medical leave.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access support resources for your personal and professional life.
  • Supplemental Benefits: Additional life insurance coverage, ambulance transportation, short term disability, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and more.

What You'll Do

Essential Responsibilities:

1. Conducts comprehensive clinical assessments and inpatient psychiatric evaluation as a part of the diagnostic process, ongoing provision of services, and/or crisis intervention.

a. Identifies individual needs and diagnoses substance use and /or mental health disorders.

b. Assesses individual risk for suicide and other safety related concerns; determines the need for medication evaluation and referral

c. Assesses individuals under the influence of substances or experiencing substance withdrawal and supports in finding stabilization options or in house social detoxification services.

2. Interprets and communicates relevant information to individuals, families and other stakeholders with the ability to communicate effectively under stress and in a fast-paced environment.

3. Provide joint response in the field working with law enforcement in Riley County to de-escalate situations and assist in triage of most appropriate level of care referral. Must have the physical capacity to respond to calls at any location and be able to drive a company vehicle.

4. Aid in access to recommended services such as inpatient hospitalization, substance abuse services, outpatient therapy, Adult/Youth Community Services, and other psychiatric services as needed.

5. Complete intakes for clients admitted to the Crisis Stabilization Unit as needed to aid with closing the loop on accessing additional services upon discharge.

6. Complete other specialized evaluations as trained - Comp Evals, PAR/CBST, etc.

7. Respond to community situations as trained to provide Critical Incident Support.

8. Complete involuntary assessments as needed for those meeting that level of care need.

9. Attend court hearings for involuntary assessments completed. Court hearings are held with little notice within 72 business hours of assessment being received by the courts.

10. Meet regularly with adult clients admitted to CSU to aid in discharge planning.

11. Meet and comply with all administrative and clinical documentation requirements for clinical staff.

12. Attend and actively participate in clinical supervision.

13. Complete and stay up to date on all State of Kansas required trainings and requirements for position.

14. Perform all other reasonably related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor or other management personnel.

title: Technical Operator - AM (12 Hour) Shifts
description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

The technical operator is responsible for supporting safe, efficient, and high-quality bakery production across multiple areas, including dough mixing, utility service, conveyor systems, presses, ovens, depanners, proofers, spirals, oilers, extruder depositor equipment, pan flow, sanitation, material movement, and production documentation. This role requires strong safety awareness, mechanical aptitude, attention to product quality, accurate recordkeeping, effective communication, and the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:
  • Schedule: Will be a 12-hour shift on a rotational schedule in a 2-2-3 pattern.
      • AM Shift: 6a-6p
  • A "2-2-3 schedule" refers to a common work pattern where employees work two days, have two days off, then work three days, repeating in a 28-day cycle to provide 24/7 coverage, with 12-hour shifts, balancing work and frequent long weekends.
  • Starting hourly pay of $27.25/hr
  • If hired, you will be required to train on one of our three 8-hour shifts:
    • 1st (6a-2p)
    • 2nd (2p-10p)
    • 3rd (10p-6a)
  • Quarterly Incentives
  • Comprehensive Nestlé benefits after 30 days of employment
Overall Purpose
  • Maintain steady ingredient, dough, crust, pan, and product flow to prevent production interruptions.
  • Operate and monitor bakery equipment to support consistent product quality and efficient output.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and communicate equipment, process, safety, or quality concerns in a timely manner.
  • Minimize downtime, waste, safety risks, and non-conforming product through proactive monitoring and accurate documentation.
  • Support sanitation, changeovers, shutdowns, audits, and overall department readiness.
Safety, GMP, and Compliance
  • Demonstrate and follow all safety procedures, including LOTO, gang lock, evacuation procedures, PPE requirements, safe lifting practices, safe movement around conveyors and hand jacks, and awareness of slippery floors, low-clearance equipment, pinch points, and congested work areas.
  • Follow Good Manufacturing Practices consistently, including food safety, sanitation, allergen awareness, and Food Defense requirements.
  • Use chemicals according to MSDS requirements and follow established chemical handling procedures.
  • Maintain an organized and audit-ready work area to support safety, quality, and compliance expectations.
Equipment Operation and Production Flow
  • Operate and monitor mixers, panel views, scales, ingredient lifts, dough chunker trolleys, transfer conveyors, extruder depositor equipment, dough ball oilers, pan oilers, presses, ovens, depanners, proofers, spirals, product conveyors, and pan conveyor systems.
  • Maintain ingredient, dough, crust, pan, and product flow to support downstream production needs.
  • Weigh, measure, and add correct ingredients to mixers; monitor flour, slurry, oil systems, dough ball weights, and dough quality.
  • Operate equipment start-up, shutdown, production mode, changeover mode, recipe changes, run cycles, warmup functions, timers, tray rates, and fault clearing functions through panel views and related systems.
  • Support crust-to-line flow, panning tables, sheeting lines, and pan flow as assigned.
  • Operate forklift, hand jack, and material movement equipment as trained and authorized; complete required equipment inspections.
Quality, Troubleshooting, and Downtime Response
  • Monitor product quality, dough consistency, dough shape, crust quality, pan flow, belt performance, servo performance, conveyor conditions, and system faults.
  • Identify and respond to jam conditions, pan jams, dough shape issues, crust tails, out-of-spec screens, power surges, equipment failures, and other production interruptions.
  • Make minor adjustments within role expectations and promptly escalate issues that require maintenance, supervision, or cross-functional support.
  • Perform belt checks, conveyor inspections, equipment verifications, and quality checks to minimize downtime and prevent non-conforming product.
Documentation and Communication
  • Verify correct process orders, lot numbers, resource numbers, recipes, product information, and production requirements.
  • Record batch data, dump times, temperatures, lot numbers, downtime, slurry times, equipment checks, inspections, audits, and other required paperwork accurately and timely.
  • Start, close, and update process orders and enter required information into systems such as panel PCs, Hertzler, SFOL, and related production systems as applicable.
  • Communicate effectively with Bakery, Assembly, Utility, Mixer, Maintenance, Quality, and Supervisory teams using appropriate communication tools, including two-way radios when needed.
Sanitation, Changeovers, and Support Duties
  • Clean and sanitize mixers, conveyors, catch pans, surrounding areas, floors, ingredient equipment, and assigned production areas.
  • Support changeovers, shutdown procedures, mixer scraping, press die changes, depanner swaps, weight adjustments, timer resets, and equipment preparation.
  • Relieve Bakery employees for breaks and provide support to Mixer Operators, Crust Packers, Utility Service, and other assigned areas.
  • Replenish supplies, organize warehouse and production areas, remove waste, and assist with material movement as needed.
  • Perform backup duties, cross-training assignments, and other responsibilities as required to support bakery operations.
Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred, or equivalent work experience as determined by the company.
  • Basic reading, writing, computer, and math skills, including the ability to read scales, production documents, panelviews, and lot numbers.
  • Ability to complete required on-the-job training, safety training, equipment sign-offs, hand jack training, and forklift certification where applicable.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions, maintain regular attendance, and work independently or as part of a team.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment while remaining calm, organized, and focused on safety and quality.
Required Skills and Competencies
  • Strong safety mindset and strict adherence to LOTO, PPE, GMP, and sanitation requirements.
  • Mechanical aptitude and ability to identify, troubleshoot, and communicate equipment or process concerns.
  • Ability to operate panelviews, mixers, conveyors, oilers, depositor systems, ovens, proofers, depanners, scales, ingredient systems, PCs, hand jacks, and forklifts as trained.
  • High attention to detail for lot tracking, process orders, documentation, product specifications, recipes, weights, temperatures, downtime, and quality checks.
  • Effective communication, teamwork, judgment, planning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Reliability, flexibility, self-direction, and ability to support changing production needs.
Physical Requirements
  • Constant standing, walking, reaching, handling materials, bending, and working near conveyors or production equipment.
  • Frequent lifting or carrying up to 50 lbs, pushing or pulling carts and totes, twisting, crouching, stooping, rotating, and repetitive hand movement.
  • Occasional sitting, climbing stairs or ladders, kneeling, crawling, working in low-clearance areas, and working in elevated or confined production spaces.
  • Ability to use both hands and legs as needed and visually monitor product flow, equipment status, paperwork, scale readings, screens, and production conditions.
  • Hearing sufficient to detect machinery alarms, belt startups, equipment changes, and verbal or radio communication in a loud environment.
Work Environment and PPE

This position works in an indoor bakery manufacturing environment with exposure to flour dust, noise up to or above 90 dBA, hot areas, cold areas, humidity changes, fluorescent lighting, flickering lights, gas vapors, compressed air, rotating equipment, slippery floors, conveyors, moving machinery, and production congestion. Required PPE may include safety glasses, hearing protection, safety shoes, gloves, cut-resistant gloves, hard hat or bump cap, face shield as needed, apron, hair net or hood, oven mitts, knee pads, and arm guards as required by task or area.

Pay: $27.25 per hour

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

This role requires the ability to recruit in competitive and rapidly changing technical markets while delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring-manager experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand technical requirements, business objectives, team structures, target talent profiles, and critical success factors for each search.
  • Manage full life-cycle recruitment process, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer negotiation, ensuring a fanatical experience for all future Rackers.

title: Deployment Strategist Lead - India
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate.

You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them.

No two days are the same, but you should expect to:

  • Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points.

  • Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region.

  • Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions.

  • Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations.

  • Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness.

  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

  • Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models.

  • Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers.

  • Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies.

Requirements

  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations.

  • People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.

  • Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

  • Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications.

  • Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact.

  • Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Digital Product Manager - A&F Co.
description:
Job Description:

At Abercrombie & Fitch, the Digital Product Manager leads at the intersection of business, technology, and design to define and deliver customer-first, digitally enabled experiences throughout the ecosystem for our global brands.

This highly visible and collaborative role sits within A&F's User Experience and Digital Product Team, with oversight of one or more experience and services squads. You operate strategically in developing the vision and direction for your product area while tactically inspiring cross-functional teams and leading the daily activities that enable it. You are accountable not only for what ships, but for the quality, operational health, and risk posture of the product.

What Will You Be Doing?

  • Strategic thinking: Shaping strategic direction through customer insights, business context, and product vision. Connecting customer problems to squad and business goals, using competitive and market context to pitch new opportunities, articulating the trade-offs behind prioritization, and partnering with Finance to build the business case for investment.
  • Problem discovery and solution validation: Surfacing customer problems through user research, voice of customer, and data analysis; forming hypotheses with designers and analysts; and validating solutions through experiments and usability testing so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than assumption.
  • Execution and accountability: Translating vision into outcome-focused roadmaps and sprint plans, prioritizing work, resolving blockers, and aligning cross-functional partners (UX, IT, Store Operations, Data Science, Analytics, Merchandising, Finance, Marketing) to launch timelines, deployment plans, and internal communications.
  • Product operations: Owning your product area's operational health and backlog by ensuring the user experience is operating optimally in production environments.
  • Risk mitigation: Anticipating risk during planning by reviewing dependencies, timelines, and assumptions; and proposing mitigation options with clear trade-offs rather than only escalating; and owning risk visibility so stakeholders never learn of a risk first in a status meeting.
  • Craft and quality of work: Holding a high bar for the team's output by defining success criteria and acceptance standards, documenting requirements as epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, driving the validation plan end to end, and deciding when to ship versus hold, including post-launch monitoring.
  • Collaboration and influence: Facilitating alignment through story mapping, workshops, stand-ups, design reviews, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives; navigating contentious priority trade-offs productively; serving as the end-to-end subject matter expert for your product area; and coaching and giving developmental feedback to other product managers.

What Do You Need To Bring?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of digital product management experience in consumer-facing mobile and web products, with a track record of bringing new and innovative customer experiences to market.
  • Minimum 3 years of retail industry experience or equivalent domain experience.
  • Proficiency at appropriately applying Design Thinking, Agile, and Lean methods to identify and deliver high-value business and customer outcomes through digital products.
  • Demonstrated ownership of product operations and risk in partnership with delivery managers, including backlog health, delivery cadence, dependency management, and mitigation options with clear trade-offs.
  • Well versed in modern digital technologies, with the ability to facilitate communication between business, technology, and design teams.
  • Strong communication skills and proven ability to influence at a strategic leadership level and cross functionally.
  • Strategic mindset and bias for action, with strength in strategic planning, defining OKRs, and driving business outcomes through digital products.
  • Ability to perform well in high-pressure situations, balance competing priorities, and work without direct supervision.
  • A natural leader who brings groups to consensus, coaches and mentors peers, and inspires enthusiasm toward team goals.

Benefits & Perks

As an Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) associate, you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A&F Co. is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward:

  • Incentive bonus program
  • 401(K) savings plan with company match
  • Annual companywide review process
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Associate assistance program
  • Paid parental and adoption leave
  • Access to fertility and adoption benefits through Carrot
  • Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace
  • Paid Caregiver Leave
  • Mobile Stipend
  • Paid time off and one paid volunteer day per year, allowing you to give back to your community
  • Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles and six work from anywhere weeks per year)
  • Seven associate wellness half days per year
  • Merchandise discount on all of our brands
  • Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within
  • Access to multiple Associate Resource Groups
  • Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU!

This role allows for remote work across the U.S.. Therefore, in states and cities that require the hourly or salary compensation or pay range to be included in a job posting, the recruiting pay range for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, your years of experience, your work location, comparison to other employees in similar or related roles, or market demands. The range may be modified in the future.

Company Description

Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.

The company operates a family of brands, including Abercrombie brands and Hollister brands, each sharing a commitment to offer products of enduring quality and exceptional comfort that support global customers on their journey to being and becoming who they are. Abercrombie & Fitch Co. operates stores under these brands across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East, as well as the e-commerce sites abercrombie.com, abercrombiekids.com and hollisterco.com.

Learn more about A&F Co. by visiting our corporate website here.

ABERCROMBIE & FITCH CO. IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

title: Marketing Data Scientist
description:
🎨 About OpenArt

OpenArt is an AI Storytelling and Visual Creation Platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we’re shaping that future.

🚀 Why Join OpenArt

  • Ride an inflection point. OpenArt has grown 7–10X in revenue over the past 2 years in one of the hottest categories in tech (AI-native creative tools). You're joining while the trajectory is still steep and every measurement decision compounds.

  • Own the data science practice behind one of OpenArt's biggest growth levers — marketing spend across influencer, paid, and lifecycle.

  • Work across marketing, growth, product, data engineering, and finance — one of the most cross-functional roles in the company.

  • Build from 0 → 1. The attribution model, channel taxonomy, and measurement stack are being laid down right now; you'll help finish the build and then run it.

  • High ownership, low process, fast iteration environment.

🎯 About the Role

We're looking for a Marketing Data Scientist to be our first dedicated marketing DS, partnering with our Head of Data to build measurement, experimentation, and insights for OpenArt's marketing org — across performance marketing, influencer/UGC, and lifecycle/email.

You don't need to be an expert in every corner of marketing science. What we care about is that you're strong in the fundamentals (SQL, Python, experimentation, at least one measurement specialty), have real product and business intuition, and are hungry to grow into the harder pieces — with a Head of Data who's done all of it available to teach you.

You'll inherit and extend work already in flight — our multi-model attribution build, the Marketing Attribution Alignment with the marketing team, and live incrementality tests (Google brand vs non-brand, Director email upsell holdout). You'll also lead areas we haven't been able to cover well yet, most notably real-time influencer/UGC measurement — currently a big gap and a top priority.

🛠 What You’ll Do

Marketing measurement & reviews (weekly rhythm)

  • Own the weekly review with the influencer marketing team — bring the data, the read, and the recommendation.

  • Build and maintain real-time dashboards for influencer/UGC traffic spikes, CAC / ROAS / payback across channels, and campaign-level performance.

  • Debug attribution gaps across ad platforms, warehouse, and CRM (Meta Attribution Gap, Impact Radius, Google Ads conversion tracking are all live workstreams).

Experimentation & insights

  • Design and run incrementality tests, holdout tests, and A/B tests across marketing programs (email, paid channels, influencer where feasible).

  • Partner on HDYHAU survey design and analysis to correct platform-reported CAC.

  • Do the deep-dive analyses that shape spend decisions — creative reads, cohort/LTV analysis, channel efficiency, campaign post-mortems.

  • Work on the marketing attribution build — channel/subchannel/partner taxonomy, attribution windows, priority chain, promo code handling, multi-model attribution.

  • Contribute to per-creator influencer attribution instrumentation (unique codes / UTMs / landing pages).

  • Grow into ownership of these areas over time as you build depth.

Communication

  • Translate insights into crisp, opinionated recommendations that marketing leaders actually use — written and verbal.

  • Set the bar for experimentation rigor and marketing measurement quality at OpenArt.

🧑‍💻 What We’re Looking For

Core Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in data science, analytics, or marketing science. We'll flex level and title based on candidate strength.

  • Strong SQL and Python — comfortable working with data end-to-end without hand-holding.

  • Meaningful experience supporting a marketing, growth, or lifecycle team — you understand how marketers think and what decisions they need data to make.

  • At least one measurement specialty done well: experimentation/incrementality, attribution, MMM, marketing analytics, or growth analytics. You don't need all of them — you need one that you're actually good at.

  • Strong product/business intuition — you can look at a dashboard and know what's worth chasing.

  • Excellent communication — you can tell a clear data story to a marketer, a PM, or a CFO, and hold your own in a room with strong opinions.

  • High ownership and comfort in ambiguity — you can figure out what needs doing and go do it.

What You'll Grow Into

We don't expect you to walk in with all of the below — but if you find these interesting and want to build depth here, this role is a great place to do it:

  • Full-stack marketing attribution architecture (taxonomy, windows, multi-model, priority logic)

  • MMM (build, buy, or vendor-partner)

  • Instrumentation and UTM/tracking design at platform level

  • Cross-channel spend strategy and marketing direction

Nice to Have

  • Experience measuring influencer/creator/UGC marketing

  • Experience as an early or first data hire supporting a marketing org.

  • Familiarity with our stack: BigQuery, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, Google/Meta/TikTok/Bing/Reddit Ads, GTM, Impact, Tolt.

  • Experience in consumer product, marketplaces, creator platforms, or e-commerce.

  • Exposure to AI/ML products or generative AI.

  • Familiarity with privacy-era measurement (Consent Mode, SKAN/ATT, Privacy Sandbox).

⚙ Tech Stack You’ll Work With

BigQuery, SQL, Python, Amplitude, Metabase, Stripe, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Bing Ads, Reddit Ads, Linkedin Ads, GTM, Impact, Tolt, GCP

💰 Compensation

  • Competitive base salary and bonus program

  • Equity — meaningful ownership in what you build

  • High autonomy, high growth environment

🌍 Work Setup

  • Bay Area preferred (hybrid allowed)

  • Visa sponsorship available

  • We’ll consider remote for exceptional candidates

✉️ How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note (links to GitHub/portfolio welcome) to careers@openart.ai.

Subject line: Application – Marketing Data Scientist – <Your Name>

Optionally include:

  • A marketing measurement, experimentation, or attribution problem you're proud of solving

  • An example of a recommendation you made that changed how a marketing team spent budget

  • Your earliest start date and location/time zone

title: Sr. Analyst Consultant Relations
description:

title: Head of Product - Platforms , Reliability and Quality
description:

Some opportunities are about maintaining what already exists.

This isn't one of them.

At Netwealth, we're redesigning how technology works from the ground up. We're creating a new Platform, Reliability & Quality function that becomes the foundation every engineering team builds on, allowing great ideas to move faster, more safely and with less friction. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

We're looking for a product leader who sees platforms not as infrastructure, but as products. Someone who loves solving problems for technical customers and believes the best engineering experience is one where the secure, compliant and reliable path is also the easiest path.


Imagine your first year

You'll partner with engineering, reliability, quality, infrastructure and security leaders to shape the platform that hundreds of engineers rely on every day. You'll define the roadmap, influence priorities, champion adoption and help create the golden paths that make great software delivery feel effortless.

You'll help turn reliability into a product feature, quality into a self-service capability, and developer experience into something teams genuinely advocate for. You'll balance immediate engineering challenges with the longer-term vision of a platform that scales with Netwealth's ambitions.

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to build something new. Not just improve a platform, but define how platform product management looks at Netwealth.


Why this role matters

Technology is a critical part of Netwealth's future. As we've grown, complexity has grown with us, and we're intentionally investing in the foundations that allow innovation to compound. We believe reliable platforms, embedded quality, clear ownership and exceptional developer experience create the conditions for our teams to do their best work.

This role helps make that vision real.

You'll own product decisions across platform capabilities spanning cloud, infrastructure, developer experience, observability, CI/CD, quality engineering, test data, self-service tooling and more. You'll decide what we build, why it matters, how success is measured and whether it delivers meaningful outcomes for our engineering community.


What you'll be doing

  • Defining and evolving the product strategy and roadmap for Netwealth's engineering platform.

  • Building strong relationships with engineers and leaders to deeply understand their challenges, workflows and opportunities.

  • Driving adoption of platform capabilities through research, insight and continuous discovery.

  • Partnering with Reliability Engineering and Observability teams to embed reliability into the way we build.

  • Shaping quality engineering as a self-service capability that empowers teams.

  • Making evidence-based build, buy or blend decisions that deliver measurable value.

  • Building and growing a high-performing product management practice within a highly technical environment.

  • Translating regulatory and risk requirements into practical platform capabilities that engineers actually want to use.

About you

You have spent years working where technology, product and engineering intersect.

You understand developer platforms, cloud-native environments and modern software delivery practices. You've seen the impact great internal products can have on engineering velocity, reliability and satisfaction, and you know that adoption is often the most important measure of success.

You'll likely bring:

  • Strong expertise in technology, including significant platform or technical product leadership experience.

  • Expertise treating internal platforms as products, with clear ownership, service levels, roadmaps and adoption metrics.

  • Strong understanding of cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, containers and continuous delivery.

  • Knowledge of reliability engineering practices including SLOs, error budgets and incident management.

  • Expertise working with engineering leaders to solve complex organisational and technical challenges.

  • A collaborative leadership style that influences through credibility, evidence and relationships rather than hierarchy.

  • Expertise leading and developing product managers and technical product teams.

Why you might be interested

  • Opportunities to build a platform product function within a ASX Fintech from the ground up don't come along often.

  • influencing how engineers work is a unique and rewarding challenge with support from Melbourne based Exec and leadership team.

  • If you're energised by platform thinking, developer experience, reliability and meaningful technology transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

Life At Netwealth

At Netwealth, we believe a fulfilling career is built on growth, balance, and belonging. Our people are our greatest strength, and we’re committed to supporting you at every stage of life because when you thrive, so do we.

We're proud to be recognised as one of Australia's top 5 companies for Career Development (endorsed by WORK180). From further education and diverse training opportunities to strong support for internal mobility. Your career can grow here.

Our flexible hybrid model supports balance, with just 4 days in the office each fortnight. When you’re in, you’ll enjoy working from one of our modern, thoughtfully designed spaces across Australia – including our state-of-the-art Melbourne CBD office. All locations feature contemporary facilities to make your day comfortable, and in Melbourne, you’ll also enjoy perks like end-of-trip amenities and daily breakfast to make your commute easier.

We offer benefits designed for your wellbeing and personal development, including;

  • Family-friendly support: Paid parental leave and a fully funded school holiday program

  • Wellness perks: CU Health (virtual healthcare), income protection, flu shots, wellness weeks, retail discounts and financial wellbeing services

  • A vibrant culture: social events, trivia nights, and corporate sports

  • Employee Resource Groups: LGBTQIA+, DAWN (Development and Accelerating Women at Netwealth), Culture Group and Carers Group

We're proud of our inclusive and diverse workforce and encourage everyone to bring their genuine selves to work. It's one of our core values. We're committed to equity and inclusion through our gender equality, disability, LGBTQIA+, wellbeing and cultural initiatives. And we're certified by WORK180, Family Friendly Workplaces and Great Places to Work.

If you're excited by the opportunity but don't meet every requirements, we still encourage you to apply. Research shows people often hesitate unless they tick every box. We value potential and passion just as much.

title: Senior Simulation Engineer (Optical & Photonics)
description:
Senior Simulation Engineer – Optical & Photonics

Temecula, CA | Full-Time

Summary:

The Senior Simulation Engineer – Optical & Photonics is a highly technical engineering role responsible for the high-fidelity modeling, simulation, and virtual prototyping of advanced photonic integrated circuits (PICs). This individual will design and optimize high-performance III-V and Silicon Photonics devices, including lasers, modulators, photodetectors, and passive optical components.

Working closely with device designers, fabrication teams, and an in-house foundry, this role serves as a critical bridge between theoretical modeling and physical device implementation. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in computational photonics, semiconductor physics, multi-physics simulation, and the development of photonic products from concept through manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, model, and simulate advanced III-V and Silicon Photonics devices and photonic integrated circuits (PICs)
  • Develop high-fidelity models for active and passive components, including DFB/DBR lasers, SOAs, EAM/MZM modulators, UTC photodiodes, optical couplers, WDM devices, and 90-degree hybrids
  • Lead multi-physics simulations combining optical, electrical, and thermal models, including analysis of self-heating and other device-performance effects
  • Optimize RF performance for high-speed modulators and optical-electrical conversion efficiency
  • Optimize epitaxy layers, quantum well designs, optical modes, and impedance matching across heterogeneous material interfaces
  • Model and optimize III-V and Silicon heterogeneous integration for next-generation photonic devices
  • Partner directly with internal fabrication and device-design teams to translate simulation results into actionable device layouts
  • Support HPIC layouts, process design rules, DRC (Design Rule Check), and LVS (Layout Versus Schematic) activities to ensure tapeout accuracy
  • Execute virtual Design of Experiments (DOE) to predict device performance, reliability, and manufacturing behavior
  • Validate simulation results against internal laboratory characterization data and refine models and material parameters based on measured performance
  • Develop automated simulation and data-analysis workflows using Python and/or MATLAB
  • Analyze large technical datasets and use statistical methods to identify trends, optimize performance, and communicate results
  • Troubleshoot discrepancies between simulated and measured device performance and recommend design or process improvements
  • Present complex technical findings, design trade-offs, and recommendations to engineering teams, leadership, and customers

Desired Skills:

  • Deep expertise in Silicon Photonics, III-V photonics, photonic integrated circuits, and semiconductor device modeling
  • Expert-level proficiency with Ansys Lumerical, including FDTD, MODE, DEVICE, and INTERCONNECT
  • Experience with photonics simulation platforms such as Synopsys RSoft/OptSim and Zemax/Speos
  • Experience with RF and electromagnetic simulation tools such as Keysight ADS, Ansys HFSS, or CST Microwave Studio
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for simulation automation, modeling, and large-scale data analysis
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor physics, including bandgap engineering, carrier dynamics, recombination mechanisms, band structures, and quantum well design
  • Experience modeling optical, electrical, thermal, and RF interactions in high-performance photonic devices
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication and how epitaxy growth, etching profiles, and metallization affect optical and electrical device performance
  • Familiarity with fiber coupling, optical packaging, and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO)
  • Experience with DRC, LVS, process design rules, and tapeout processes
  • Experience using statistical analysis tools such as JMP or Minitab is preferred
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly in identifying and resolving discrepancies between modeled and measured performance
  • Excellent technical communication skills with the ability to explain complex engineering trade-offs to technical teams, leadership, and customers
  • Proven ability to collaborate across device design, fabrication, characterization, and manufacturing teams

Education & Experience:

Minimum Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline with an emphasis on computational photonics

  • 10+ years of industrial experience in photonics simulation and design
  • Extensive hands-on experience with III-V and Silicon Photonics device modeling
  • Proven track record of bringing photonic or semiconductor products from concept and simulation through fabrication and manufacturing
  • Significant experience with active and passive photonic device simulation, multi-physics modeling, and model validation
  • Experience working directly with semiconductor fabrication or an in-house foundry environment strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience translating simulation results into manufacturable device designs

Work Environment & Travel:

  • Full-time position in a temperature-controlled office and laboratory environment
  • Role requires prolonged use of high-resolution monitors for detailed simulation and modeling work
  • Expected travel is less than 25%
  • Position is based at a facility operating under International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
  • Applicants must qualify as a “U.S. person” under ITAR, which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents (Green Card holders), political asylees, and refugees

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Comprehensive benefits package including:
    • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
    • 401(k)
    • Company-paid life insurance
    • Company-paid disability coverage
    • Paid holidays and vacation
    • Birthday leave
    • Gym membership discounts

description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Job Description

When you’re part of the team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do important work, like helping customers find cures for cancer, protecting the environment, or making sure our food is safe. Your work will have real-world impact, and you’ll be supported in achieving your career goals.

How will you make an impact?

Unity Lab Services, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, provides integrated solutions, instrument services, and enterprise services to our customers.

The Regional Service Specialist – Liquid Chromatography/Mass Spectrometry is responsible for providing advanced technical and field service support to customers throughout the assigned region (California, Oregon, and Washington). This position will manage key aspects of customer service and relationship management, including installations, repairs, preventative maintenance, technical troubleshooting, and escalations.

The Regional Service Specialist will also serve as a technical resource for Field Service Engineers within the region, supporting mentoring, certification, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement efforts. This individual will be customer-focused, an advocate for Thermo Fisher Scientific, and committed to improving service performance, customer satisfaction, and growth within the region.

What will you do?

  • Maintain a strong customer focus while working in conjunction with Field Service Management, Instrument Sales, and other internal partners.
  • Utilize customer management software to track service calls, manage parts inventories, document activities, and complete assigned job tasks.
  • Review customer reports and documentation and inspect malfunctioning products to determine the nature and scope of technical issues.
  • Provide advanced technical assistance to Field Service Engineers by reviewing service documentation, troubleshooting instrument issues, and helping determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Analyze inspection and troubleshooting findings to determine the source of problems and recommend repairs, replacement, or other corrective actions.
  • Coordinate problem resolution with engineering, customer service, sales, and other personnel to expedite repairs and improve customer experience.
  • Analyze instrument-generated data and performance reports related to technical issues and recommend modifications or corrective actions that may help prevent future occurrences.
  • Serve as a communication link between customers and Thermo Fisher Scientific to help ensure effective and timely service.
  • Develop and conduct training on the safe operation of equipment and demonstrate technical skills to colleagues and customers.
  • Maintain required continuous education, technical training, and certifications for advanced products.
  • Perform on-site installations, repairs, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and other field service activities as required.

Regional Service Specialist Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and support for customer escalations within the assigned region.
  • Support the mentoring, development, and certification of Field Service Engineers within the region to improve technical readiness and customer response.
  • Review Service Data/Metrics to identify areas of improvement for individual FSE’s
  • Partner with other Regional Service Specialists on best practices and knowledge sharing
  • Coordinate problem resolution between engineering, sales, customer service, Field Service, and other internal partners to enable expedited repairs and improve customer satisfaction.
  • Attend and/or host "Hot Account" meetings as the Regional Service Specialist representative when required.
  • Serve as a regional technical resource for complex LC/MS service issues and escalations.
  • Partner with regional service leadership to identify opportunities to improve service performance, technical capability, customer satisfaction, and revenue growth.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support regional business and customer needs.

How will you get here?

Minimum Experience, Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Sciences, Engineering, or equivalent job experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience as a Service Engineer preferred, particularly working with Analytical instrumentation.
  • Hands-on experience with Liquid Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry (LC/MS) instrumentation is required.
  • Specific experience with Orbitrap is preferred.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to establish strong customer relationships and collaborate across internal teams.
  • Ability to prioritize service requests and produce clear, concise, and accurate documentation.
  • Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to Field Service Engineers.

Location and Regional Coverage

  • Position is located on the West Coast (California, Oregon, and Washington) and following prime locations (Seattle, Los Angeles, Irvine, or San Diego areas).
  • Responsible for supporting customers and Field Service teams within the assigned regional territory.
  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned region as business and customer needs require.

Physical Work Requirements

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

Summary of Job Duties:

The Clinical Pharmacy Specialist (CPS) for Ambulatory Care provides comprehensive pharmacotherapy support in the ambulatory care setting, serving as a consultative resource to providers on evidence-based therapeutic alternatives, medication optimization, and drug information. The Ambulatory CPS collaborates daily with the interdisciplinary care team to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care across a broad ambulatory population, including direct patient care services provided under approved collaborative practice agreements. Responsibilities include reviewing and interpreting medication orders, laboratory data, and complete medication profiles to ensure safe, effective, and appropriate drug therapy while identifying and mitigating potential drug interactions and medication-related problems. The Ambulatory CPS contributes to clinical protocol development and quality initiatives and serves as a preceptor for pharmacy students and residents. The Ambulatory CPS is expected to obtain credentialing as a Clinical Pharmacy Specialist through the UAMS Medical Board Credentialing Committee within six months of employment.
