title: People Analyst
description:
Unbottle YOUR Potential at Pepsi Bottling Ventures!

At Pepsi, we spread home-grown joy, in our special Pepsi Bottling Ventures way! Pepsi Bottling Ventures is the nation’s largest private bottler and distributor of Pepsi beverages. Pepsi Bottling Ventures is based in NC, SC, MD, & DE.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

CURRENT PBV EMPLOYEE, please login to Workday to complete the job application. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

If you are NOT a current employee, please click “Apply” and complete job application.

Job Description

Pepsi Bottling Ventures is seeking a People Analyst to join our team.

Who We Are

We are jointly owned by Suntory and PepsiCo. Suntory is a family-owned business founded in Japan more than 125 years ago that is known globally for their beverages and innovative spirit. PepsiCo has a 125-year plus legacy as a global leader in convenient foods and beverages. We represent Suntory’s non-alcoholic beverage industry in the United States and have an 80-year plus legacy of providing PepsiCo products to the Carolinas and beyond.

What We Do

We make, sell, and distribute PepsiCo and other beverages. We do business in five states and sell PepsiCo beverages to most of the market in our geographic regions. We also develop our own line of beverages, producing and distributing a growing product line nationally.

What Makes Us Unique

We bring you the beverages you love. We bring PepsiCo’s beloved beverages and more to you and our customers. As a part of Suntory, we believe in dreaming big and boldly pursuing our dreams, growing for good, and giving back to society. We innovate to create new beverages, like our Nature’s Twist refreshing lemonade line, and we continuously expand our beverage portfolio to bring you and our customers joy.

What We Look for in Team Members

We value integrity, teamwork, accountability, adaptability, and communication in all we do and expect from all team members. We’d love to receive your application and talk with you about your interest in the position if the overview below describes you.

People Analyst Role Overview

The People Analyst supports data-informed workforce decisions by collecting, analyzing, and translating people data into clear insights, dashboards, and recommendations. This position partners with People & Culture (P&C) leaders to measure workforce trends, improve recruiting and retention outcomes, support workforce planning, and evaluate the effectiveness of P&C programs while maintaining data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain P&C dashboards, recurring reports, and workforce scorecards for recruiting, retention, engagement, headcount, turnover, and other key people metrics.

  • Collect, clean, validate, and reconcile people data from HRIS, ATS, payroll, engagement, performance, and other systems to ensure reliable reporting and decision support.

  • Analyze workforce trends, identify risks and opportunities, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for P&C and business leaders.

  • Support workforce planning, talent acquisition analytics, organizational effectiveness initiatives, and P&C program measurement through ad hoc analysis and project support.

  • Prepare presentations, data stories, and written summaries that explain trends, implications, and recommended actions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Maintain documentation for metric definitions, reporting processes, data governance standards, and recurring analytics deliverables.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, or related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

  • Two (2) to four (4) years of experience in HR analytics, HRIS reporting, workforce analytics, talent acquisition analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical role.

  • Strong Excel skills required; experience with Power BI, HRIS, ATS, survey platforms, and data visualization tools preferred.

  • Knowledge of HR processes, metrics, data privacy, and confidential information handling required.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, business acumen, data storytelling, written and verbal communication, stakeholder partnership, discretion with confidential information, and ability to translate complex data into practical business recommendations.

​

Compensation and Benefits

As part of your total compensation package, you will also receive the following benefits:

  • Paid time off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days, parental leave, and bereavement leave

  • 401(k) with a company match

  • Medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance options, as well as supplemental health plan options, including accident, critical illness, and hospitalization

  • Saving and spending accounts

  • Company-paid telemedicine services

  • Free counseling and information services

  • Wellness program

  • Company-paid life insurance

  • Company-paid disability coverage

  • Adoption assistance

  • Education assistance

  • Legal service plan option

  • Pay advance option

Unfortunately, we will be unable to offer visa sponsorships to candidates.

title: Seasonal Trip Development Coordinator
description:
Excited to grow your career?


We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!


Our people make all the difference in our success.


About the Role:
The seasonal Trip Development Coordinator plays an important role in supporting the Trip Development Team's winter projects. In this role, you'll help improve the quality, accuracy, and usability of the resources and systems that enable our trips to run smoothly and at the highest level of quality. Projects may include reviewing and organizing Field Staff and Field Expert resources, auditing trip data, conducting quality research, and helping improve internal tools and workflows. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data, identifying patterns, and bringing structure to complex information. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, organization, curiosity and business-minded orientation, and an ability to quickly learn new systems. You'll thrive if you enjoy improving how things work and are motivated by making information more accurate, accessible, and useful for others.

What you'll be doing:

  • In Ascent, Teams, SharePoint, and other Backroads systems, review, update, and organize internal resources to ensure content is accurate, current, and easy to find and use.
  • Conduct audits of trip and regional content in Ascent and the On Trip App to identify inconsistencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Perform quality research and data analysis to support decision-making and project planning for the FE Program and other partners in Trip Development
  • Help standardize processes and workflows to improve efficiency and consistency across the department.
  • Assist with developing, testing, and improving tools and systems to support efficiency across TD, leveraging emerging technologies including Copilot AI.
  • Collaborate with Trip Development partners, including the Field Expert Program, Guest Focus, and Hotel Operations, as well as cross-functional partners to gather information and implement complex initiatives.
  • Contribute to a variety of projects that support trip quality, department resources, efficiency, and continuous improvement efforts.


What You'll Need to Be Successful:

  • 2+ seasons of Trip Expert experience is preferred but not required.
  • Informed, business-minded, and global perspective on Backroads.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Excellent organizational instincts and time management skills.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to identify patterns, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, and large amounts of information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Comfortable working independently while also collaborating effectively with a team.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.


About the Department:
The Trip Development Team is responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving Backroads trips and the guest experience. Working closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, and Field Staff, the team manages trip information, quality standards, resources, systems, and processes that support both Field Staff and guests. The TD team helps increase operational efficiency and drive quality improvements.

Work Environment:

  • Full-time seasonal position (October-March). Exact timing based on departmental needs and candidate availability
  • Preferred location is on-site, in Berkeley, CA. Flexibility on the location of this role may be considered for highly qualified candidates and business need. Location must be within the US.
  • 4 days in-office, 1 day work from home (Wednesdays)
  • Housing included in local Backroads Field Staff House
  • Compensation is determined according to the candidate's experience and qualifications. Pay rates may differ depending on work location, with individuals located in designated hubs or within the operations area potentially qualifying for higher compensation compared to those in fully remote positions. The posted compensation band is for a Berkeley, CA based role.

title: Continuing Education Instructor, Children’s Book: Portfolio and Professional Practice
description:
CE Overview

RISD Continuing Education functions within the larger context of RISD, an institution with an unparalleled reputation for producing highly-skilled, successful, and internationally renowned creative practitioners. With more than 100 years of expertise nurturing critical making, thinking, and innovation in art and design we facilitate personal and professional development by engaging students in sustained exploration and learning in the creative disciplines. With a commitment to centering inclusivity, diversity and equity in executing key responsibilities, RISD Continuing Education instructors plan, organize, teach, and provide feedback to promote and direct student learning in keeping with the institutional learning-centered values and in a manner that meets essential competencies of artists and designers.

Job Description

RISD Continuing Education instructors plan, organize, teach, and provide feedback to promote and direct student learning in keeping with the institutional learning-centered values and in a manner that meets the essential competencies of an artist and designer. Our instructors respond to students in a timely manner and communicate with the discipline and division via college-provided tools and resources. We welcome instructors whose teaching experience addresses historically underrepresented communities.

The successful candidate should be prepared to teach asynchronous online courses to a diverse group of students from a range of disciplines, through online content development, including recorded video demonstrations and/or lectures provided weekly for the course duration. Candidates should be prepared to develop culturally diverse syllabi for studio and seminar courses, and weekly feedback to student work that models constructive criticism that encourages students to grow creatively and intellectually.

We are looking for instructors whose specialty is in children’s book illustration and professional-based topics in the field. The successful candidate will be able to teach topics including writing book proposals, submission guidelines, how to seek representation, what makes a well-rounded portfolio, and what it is like to work with an editor on a book project. A variety of publishing approaches, such as self-publishing and traditional publishing will need to be discussed as well. As the final course in the Children’s Book Illustration Microcredential, the instructor will teach students how to create and further develop the content in one’s illustration portfolio, how to edit the body of work, and how to present it to the picture book publishing industry. Additionally, the instructor will teach skills to scan traditional work and digitally optimize work for online portfolios, marketing and submissions. The ideal candidate is a published children’s book illustrator with experience teaching adult students professional development.

Required Knowledge/Skills/Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree required

  • A track record of professional experience at companies successfully doing related work, and/or a robust, creative, intellectually and critically engaged design or studio practice, as evidenced by recognition in publications, commissions, exhibitions, awards and/or collaborative projects

  • Teaching experience, including the ability to create syllabi and lesson plans, and how to tie those to learning outcomes

  • Ability to accept and act upon constructive feedback from course evaluations by students and staff

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills

  • Ability to meet RISD’s technology requirements

  • Experience leading classes and critiques that model inclusivity in an environment of diverse learners

  • Ability to tailor instruction to meet the needs students with a wide range of pre-existing skills

  • In-depth knowledge of Children's Book Illustration and Publishing

Preferred Knowledge/Skills/Experience

  • Teaching experience in a collegiate or adult education setting that addresses underrepresented communities

  • Online teaching experience, or experience utilizing an LMS

  • MFA preferred or equivalent in established professional practice in area of study

  • Lifelong learning orientation with demonstrated interest in learning about new developments in their area of study

  • Ability to empathically relate to a wide range of student perspectives and maturely handle interpersonal issues that may arise

  • Experience in course content development, including video creation of demonstrations and lectures

title: Senior Director of Public Charging
description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Vice President, Sales – Public, Fleet & Auto

What You Will Be Doing

This role owns two connected functions: strategic account management for a portfolio of top-tier public charging accounts (quota carrying), and segment blueprint creation — structured, evidence-based playbooks for each priority public charging segment (CPOs of all types & Retail and Destination) that capture customer economics, procurement behavior, technical requirements, and competitive dynamics. The blueprints are not a static reference document — they are the primary mechanism for feeding validated, field-tested segment intelligence into Product, Policy, R&D, and Marketing, so those functions build roadmap, positioning, and regulatory strategy around real account behavior rather than assumption. The person in this seat reports to the Vice President of Sales, North America and acts as the connective tissue between account-level reality and company-level decisions.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

Segment Blueprint Creation

  • Build and own segment-specific blueprints (CPO & Retail) that document customer economics, procurement patterns, technical/product requirements, and competitive positioning within each segment
  • Translate blueprint findings into structured inputs for four functions: Product (feature and roadmap priorities), Policy (regulatory and incentive positioning), R&D (technical requirements), and Marketing (positioning and messaging). Own this as a standing feedback loop with defined cadence, not a one-time handoff
  • Generate new growth with major market movers within each sub-segment
  • Maintain and refresh blueprints against market, competitive, and policy shifts; define and track KPIs that indicate segment traction and blueprint accuracy

Strategic Account Management

  • Own relationships for a portfolio of top-tier public charging accounts; be the primary point of accountability for account health, growth, and retention
  • Lead negotiation and contract structuring for major, complex, multi-year agreements
  • Drive footprint expansion within key public charging accounts, deepening existing relationships to secure large, repeat business
  • Coordinate cross-functional pursuit teams (sales, marketing, legal, finance, product) on major RFPs and large bids, using blueprint data to sharpen proposal strategy

title: Warehouse Purchaser
description:
Build the Backbone of Kansas City's Best Electrical Team
For more than 40 years, Teague Electric has powered homes, businesses, and communities across the Kansas City area. Our success isn't built solely on the work happening in the field—it's built on the people behind the scenes who make that work possible.
We're looking for a Warehouse Purchaser who understands that having the right material, at the right price, at the right time can make or break a project. If you're organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with vendors, and know how to stay ahead of material needs, we want to talk to you!
At Teague, purchasing is more than placing orders. This position plays a critical role in keeping our warehouse stocked, our projects moving, and our field teams productive. At Teague, people matter. We believe in teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement, and treating each other with respect. Many of our employees have built long-term careers here because they know they're valued, supported, and given opportunities to grow.
What You'll Do
  • Purchase electrical materials, tools, equipment, and supplies needed for warehouse inventory and active projects
  • Work with vendors and supply houses to obtain pricing, availability, and lead times
  • Create and process purchase orders accurately and efficiently
  • Communicate material availability, backorders, substitutions, and potential delays to the appropriate teams

What We're Looking For

Anyone can place an order. The right purchaser helps keep an entire operation moving. title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About the role and team

As a Staff Software Engineer at Uber, you will be a technical anchor for the foundational systems that move the world - from building the next generation of orchestration platforms to architecting the stacks that power our global applications. You will navigate the "messy" reality of complex infrastructures spanning global data centers and multiple cloud providers, supporting a diverse variety of workloads. You’ll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information and own the outcomes of global architectural choices.

The Core Platform Foundations team owns defining, monitoring, and controlling operations for the infrastructure that supports Uber’s virtual computing environments. We are the lowest software layer abstracting the underlying fleet of hosts whether on prem or on the cloud, and as such we are the guardians of quality and security of the production host. We support many Core Platform’s dependencies to ensure we provision the Uber flavored base host quickly and reliably, as well as help architect the new standards as we increase support for cloud native infra use cases. The software that this team owns impacts all of Uber's production fleet - quality, security, and operational mindedness are highly valued, as well as compassion for the developer experience.

What you’ll do

  • Driving initiatives and change between stakeholder platforms and cloud providers including the ingestion of new host and volume types, os/kernel upgrades, and improving availability and performance of vms and storage
  • Design and build end-to-end systems for orchestration, monitoring, or frameworks that stand the test of massive global scale, high availability, and resiliency against zonal disasters
  • Provide deep technical mentorship across the stack, ensuring architecture and implementations are robust, extensible, and secure.
  • Create best-in-class tools and frameworks that increase the velocity and quality of hundreds of internal engineering teams.
  • Lead and mentor engineers, reviewing code and designs while fostering a culture of continuous learning and humility.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, and Operations across the globe to drive large-scale projects and align technical investments with business value.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience building scalable, fault-tolerant products or platforms, with a track record of solving strategically important problems.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, C/C++, Java, Python, or JavaScript) and the ability to define organization-wide standards.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale engineering projects through the entire lifecycle from inception to global productionization.
  • Expertise in making complex engineering/business tradeoffs, managing the implications of "buy vs. build" or "incremental vs. rewrite" decisions.
  • Experience identifying architectural gaps and acting as a multiplier to reduce technical debt across the organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) with a focus on distributed computing, system performance, or machine learning.
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects or leading industry-level technical discussions.
  • Ability to anticipate future business needs and develop extensible, modular designs that meet long-term scalability targets.

For Seattle, WA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $232,000 per year - USD $258,000 per year.

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

title: CDL Rearload Route Driver- Hermiston, OR
description:
Sanitary Disposal, a Waste Connections company, is seeking a highly safe and motivated Rear load Garbage Route Driver (CDL Required) to join our team in Hermiston, OR.

Working Schedule is Monday-Friday 5:00am-1:30pm (Or until Route is Complete, usually 9-11 Hours Shifts) with Overtime Often.

Starting wage is $31.42/HR

Safety Sensitive: Yes

The route will be operating a Rear Load GarbageTruck. If you are a dependable, team-oriented and service-driven person, with a passion for the environment, we may be the perfect place for you. Contact us today! As a CDL Driver you need to be reliable, safety-minded, and committed to providing exceptional customer service. You should also be highly organized with strong time-management and prioritization skills. It is also important that you display excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to establish and maintain professional and cooperative relationships with both customers and colleagues.

​JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to safely operate a CDL truck on specified routes to collect solid waste. Waste experience preferred but not required.

  • Ability to read route tablet and service each customer identified on the route or assigned by the dispatcher.

  • Perform routine inspection and maintenance on vehicles such as checking fluids, safety equipment, and tires.

  • Ability to perform a physically demanding job, loading and unloading, at times with no helpers.

  • Operate hydraulic hand controls to remove refuse and dispose of trash at designated facilities.

  • Courteous interaction with our customers and perform other miscellaneous job-related duties assigned.

  • Valid Class A or Class B CDL license with air brake endorsement required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Ability to function in a wide variety of environments to withstand exposure to all kinds of weather while completing work assignments (i.e., rain, heat, sun, cold).

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and move/maneuver up to 100 pounds.

  • Ability to mount and dismount the truck multiple times every day while on route.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Local CDL Route with a set schedule

  • Yearly Safety Bonus of up to $1,500

  • Yearly Boot Allowance

  • Performance-based career growth potential

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans

  • Income Protection Plans (Life Insurance, Short Term/Long Term Disability)

  • 401(k) with a generous company match

  • Flexible Spending Account

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Emergency Travel Assistance

Working Conditions and Physical Effort:

  • Extensive physical activity. Requires strenuous physical work; heavy lifting, pushing, or pulling required of objects over 50 pounds.

  • Work environment involves some exposure to physical risks such as moving mechanical parts. Which require following basic safety precautions.

  • The employee is exposed to outside weather, including frequent wet and/or humid conditions, as well as exposure to fumes and vibration. Noise level is usually moderate.

To be consider any of our current openings you must complete an application at www.careers.wasteconnections.com .

Application information and additional instructions can be found once you select your position of interest.

We offer excellent benefits including medical, dental, vision, flexible spending account, long term & short term disability, life insurance, 401K retirement and unlimited opportunities to "Connect with Your Future". A link to our benefits overview can be found here:

Waste Connections is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator - Service Cloud
description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit and . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit .

About the Role:

We’re seeking a Senior Salesforce Administrator - Service Cloud to own the configuration, governance, and continuous improvement of our Service Cloud platform. This is a full-time, regular position on our Engineering & Technology team. You’ll be the platform owner for how our support and care teams work inside Salesforce — case management, Omni-Channel routing, the Service Console, and the automation that keeps agents productive and SLAs on track. You’ll partner closely with Support Operations and CX leaders to translate their process needs into scalable, well-governed Salesforce configuration, and you’ll mentor other admins as our Service Cloud footprint grows.

What You Will Do

  • Own case management configuration — assignment/escalation rules, case queues, record types, and Omni-Channel routing (queue-based, skill-based, and external).

  • Configure and maintain the Lightning Service Console, utility bar, and Knowledge base architecture, including article lifecycle and taxonomy.

  • Build and tune entitlements, SLAs, and milestones to keep support commitments visible and enforceable.

  • Design declarative automation in Flow for case routing, notifications, and agent workflows, partnering with engineering when logic requires Apex.

  • Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules; own sandbox refreshes and release management, testing new Salesforce releases against our Service Cloud configuration before rollout.

  • Own reporting and dashboards on support KPIs — case volume, SLA adherence, and the impact of automation and AI-assisted routing.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Support Operations and CX leaders on process design, training, and adoption of new Salesforce capabilities.

  • Mentor junior administrators and analysts on platform patterns, automation standards, and documentation.

  • Lead requirements-gathering workshops and manage stakeholders across Support, CX, and Engineering.

What You’ll Bring

  • Required Experience: 5-7+ years as a Salesforce Administrator, including ownership of a Service Cloud implementation supporting a large, complex user base.

  • Required Certification: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator.

  • Preferred Certifications: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II (Advanced Administrator), Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, and/or Salesforce Certified Agentforce Service Consultant (formerly Service Cloud Consultant).

  • Hands-on experience with Omni-Channel, Case Management, Entitlements & Milestones, Lightning Knowledge, and Flow Builder.

  • Experience with CTI/telephony integrations (e.g., Salesforce Voice, formerly known as Service Cloud Voice) and Einstein for Service (bots, case classification, next best action) a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead sandbox refreshes, release management, and org governance for a complex, multi-integration Salesforce environment.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with a track record of translating Support and CX process needs into scalable, well-governed configuration.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Why Hims & Hers

At Hims & Hers, the platform you configure is the one our support and care teams touch every single day. As a Senior Salesforce Administrator - Service Cloud, you’ll shape how quickly and effectively those teams can respond to the people who rely on us — work that translates directly into a faster, better care experience.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

title: Project Manager, Contract
description:
Likeable is looking for a freelance Project Manager who is a deadline wizard, resourcing expert, and master communicator that knows how to effectively plan and collaborate to ensure every project gets done on time

The Project Manager ensures quality control throughout the life cycle of a project — from concept to deployment. Project managers are responsible for successful delivery of scoped assets to the client, including ensuring that deliverables are on time and adhere to all objectives outlined in the project brief. This position is responsible for routing feedback, sourcing needed assets from our contacts, and providing updates on deliverables to the team and/or within trackers.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Ensure the team clearly understands the status of a project throughout all phases, including completed tasks, pending deliverables, timelines and outstanding items — in and out of our project management tool.
  • Perform daily project tracking including resource management, inventory allocation/tracking, and workflow supervision of multiple projects.
  • Route completed assets, client feedback, revisions back and forth between client-facing calendars and our internal teams and project management software.
  • Assure timelines are met, including completion dates, feedback request dates, revisioning, and ultimate completion of a project.
  • Juggle multiple projects and deliverables with ease.
  • Establish and maintain all creative workflow processes in an extremely fast-paced, collaborative agency environment.
  • Build out and enforce internal project timelines in our project management system and work with the account management team to ensure their client-facing timelines match our internal process.
  • Delegate project tasks based on individual strengths, skill sets, experience levels, and bandwidth.
Competencies
  • Extremely detail-oriented with a strong ability to multitask
  • Proven working experience in project management
  • Technical Competence/Proficiency with PM Software such as ClickUp
  • Critical thinking with the innate ability to solve problems
  • A real understanding of time & resource management
  • Highly organized
  • Detail Oriented
  • Self starter with great time management skills
  • Ability to keep a team on track with what is due and when
  • Accountability to timelines and calendar commitments

Requirements:

  • Experience managing projects, coordinating teams, and/or other planning-related duties, preferably in the social space
  • Ability to work alone, under pressure, with extremely tight deadlines
  • Experience in the project management software, ClickUp
  • Proficiency in Google Sheets
  • Strong understanding of social content production workflows
  • A cool, calm, collected approach to resourcing and problem solving
  • Understanding of relevant social media platforms and their requirements
About us:
Likeable is one of the first-ever pure-play social media agencies and remain rooted in social-first thinking to this day. With a strong expertise in finance, food, and fun, we’ve been named a Top 50 Ad Agency and Top 50 Fastest-Growing Women-Owned Businesses by WPO and American Express OPEN as well as Crain’s 6th “Best Place To Work in NYC.”

title: Manufacturing Training Program Manager
description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

Skydio is seeking a Manufacturing Training Program Manager to build and scale our manufacturing talent development programs. This role combines operational excellence with workforce strategy, ensuring employees receive exceptional onboarding and technical training while developing long-term partnerships that create sustainable manufacturing talent pipelines.

You will own the manufacturing training ecosystem—from learning management systems and training effectiveness to workforce partnerships, public funding opportunities, and hiring programs. Working cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Production, Engineering, Recruiting, HR, Quality, and external partners, you will build the systems and relationships that enable Skydio's continued manufacturing growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Manufacturing Training & Workforce Development

  • Own the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of manufacturing training programs across production operations.

  • Schedule, coordinate, and administer instructor-led, on-the-job, and digital training for manufacturing employees.

  • Design and continuously improve onboarding programs that accelerate employee readiness and productivity.

  • Develop cross-training strategies that increase workforce versatility and manufacturing flexibility.

  • Evaluate training effectiveness through KPIs including certification rates, time-to-proficiency, quality performance, safety metrics, and production readiness.

  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, EHS, and Quality to develop standardized work instructions, training curricula, and certification programs for compliance, new products, and manufacturing processes.

  • Develop professional development programs and training to

Learning Management & Program Management

  • Act as the primary Manufacturing System Owner for the LMS, overseeing the integrity of qualification tracking, employee certifications, training documentation, and reporting to ensure constant audit readiness.

  • Develop scalable training infrastructure, processes, and reporting dashboards to support a growing manufacturing workforce.

  • Ensure training documentation meets quality, regulatory, and operational requirements.

  • Manage training schedules, instructor coordination, employee certifications, and training records.

Workforce Partnerships & Talent Pipeline

  • Lead partnerships with public agencies, workforce development organizations, educational institutions, and community partners to strengthen Skydio's manufacturing talent pipeline.

  • Serve as the primary liaison with colleges, universities, workforce boards, apprenticeship programs, and strategic manufacturing partners.

  • Develop and implement workforce development programs that reduce dependence on staffing agencies through sustainable talent pipelines.

  • Coordinate candidate referrals, workforce program participation, onboarding logistics, internships, apprenticeships, and hiring initiatives.

  • Organize and support hiring events, manufacturing tours, career fairs, and workforce engagement activities in partnership with Recruiting, Production, and external organizations.

Public Funding & Strategic Initiatives

  • Identify and pursue workforce development grants, manufacturing incentives, tax credits, and public funding opportunities that support manufacturing workforce growth.

  • Manage administrative requirements associated with public funding, including reporting, documentation, compliance, and performance metrics.

  • Monitor workforce development initiatives and manufacturing programs to identify strategic partnership opportunities.

  • Build scalable systems for managing workforce partnerships, community engagement, and external stakeholder relationships.

What Makes You a Good Fit:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Operations, Manufacturing, Education, Industrial Engineering, Human Resources, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing training, workforce development, operations program management, or a related field.

  • Experience administering Learning Management Systems (LMS) or enterprise training platforms.

  • Strong program management experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Experience developing training programs, onboarding systems, and competency-based learning.

  • Demonstrated success building partnerships with educational institutions, workforce organizations, government agencies, or community partners.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across technical, operational, and external stakeholders.

  • Experience using data and metrics to evaluate program effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-tech manufacturing, aerospace, robotics, electronics, automotive, or medical device manufacturing.

  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies.

  • Experience managing workforce grants, apprenticeship programs, or publicly funded workforce initiatives.

  • Familiarity with California workforce development programs and manufacturing initiatives.

  • Experience with Workday Learning, Cornerstone, Docebo, or other enterprise LMS platforms.

  • PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CPTD, APTD, CIT, or ATD certifications are a plus.

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
description:
Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy innovative industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. title: VICE PRESIDENT, FABRICATION ENGINEERING
description:
VICE PRESIDENT, FABRICATION ENGINEERING

San Diego / Riverside, CA

Salary: $190,000 - $260,000 DOE

THE OPPORTUNITY
Our client is a fast-scaling semiconductor manufacturer working at the leading edge of silicon photonics and advanced optical device integration. As the company moves from development-stage production into stable, profitable high-volume manufacturing (HVM), it is searching for a Vice President of Fabrication Engineering to own both the technical vision and the day-to-day execution of its wafer fab.

This is a top-tier executive seat with full accountability for every engineering discipline on the floor, process, process integration, equipment and maintenance, and yield enhancement. You will translate the product roadmap into fab capability, steward significant capital and operating budgets, drive technology transfers out of R&D, and build an engineering culture grounded in data, discipline, and continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Technical Strategy & Roadmap: Set and execute the long-range engineering roadmap for the fab, keeping technical capability tightly aligned with product plans, commercial commitments, and company growth targets.
  • Operational Performance: Carry ultimate accountability for the fab's core metrics — baseline wafer yield, cycle time, overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), and cost per wafer — and hold the organization to them.
  • A Unified Engineering Org: Bring process, integration, equipment, and yield teams under one direction, breaking down silos to speed new product introductions (NPI) and ensure clean, repeatable technology transfers.
  • Capital & Capacity Planning: Lead the fab's CapEx strategy — multi-million-dollar tool buys, facility and cleanroom expansion, floor-space optimization, and forward capacity planning to meet demand.
  • Supplier & Partner Strategy: Own executive-level relationships and negotiations with equipment OEMs, chemical and materials suppliers, and external foundry partners.
  • Quality & Continuity: Stand up and enforce robust quality systems (including automotive- or aerospace-grade standards where relevant) and lead the fab's response to technical excursions and supply risks to protect 24/7 continuity.
  • Cost & Budget Discipline: Build and manage the annual operating budget for fab engineering, finding structural cost-reduction opportunities that never come at the expense of yield or quality.
  • Leadership & Talent: Recruit, mentor, and scale a world-class engineering leadership bench; drive succession planning, workforce development, and a culture centered on safety and accountability.

WHO YOU'LL LEAD

  • Provide executive direction to a senior team, including the Directors of Process Engineering, Process Integration, and Equipment Engineering.
  • Own organizational design, headcount planning, and talent allocation across the full fab engineering ecosystem.
  • Set top-down goals, build performance-tracking frameworks, and coach department heads toward them.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Executive Presence: You can distill dense technical data into clear strategic direction for the board, CEO, customers, and investors.
  • HVM Fab Mastery: Proven command of high-volume semiconductor manufacturing, with real depth in silicon photonics, MEMS, or advanced CMOS nodes.
  • Business Acumen: Strong hand with large budgets, capital-equipment ROI, and cost-of-goods (COGS) reduction.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: You build alignment and navigate competing priorities across Operations, R&D, Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial.
  • Change Leadership: A track record of steering large technical organizations through rapid scaling and structural change.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Education: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field.
  • Industry Experience: 15+ years of progressive semiconductor manufacturing experience, with a working command of both front-end (FEOL) and back-end (BEOL) processing.
  • Leadership Experience: 7+ years in a senior director or executive role (e.g., Director of Fab Operations, Director of Integration or Process, or VP) leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams in a 24/7 manufacturing setting.
  • Track Record: Demonstrated success scaling a fab from low-volume R&D or prototyping into stable, profitable high-volume manufacturing.

NICE TO HAVE

  • PhD in a relevant engineering field with published work in semiconductor or photonics technology.
  • Hands-on experience with silicon photonics integration or advanced optical communication device manufacturing.
  • Certifications in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma executive leadership, or advanced project management (PMP).

WORK ENVIRONMENT & TRAVEL

  • Time is split across an executive office, boardrooms, and the cleanroom floor.
  • Periodic fab walkthroughs require full cleanroom PPE (bunny suit).
  • Up to 25% travel for vendor evaluations, customer executive reviews, and industry conferences.

ELIGIBILITY
This role is based at a facility governed by U.S. export-control (ITAR) requirements. All applicants must qualify as a "U.S. person" under ITAR — a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (green-card holder), asylee, or refugee.

title: Director, Autonomous Vehicle (AV)
description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Vice President, Sales – Public, Fleet & Auto

What You Will Be Doing

This role owns three connected functions: strategic account management for a portfolio of top-tier AV accounts, segment blueprint creation for the AV segment, and end-to-end project management of AV charging deployments — from site acquisition through installation, commissioning, and ongoing SLA-backed operations. Because AV operations run on mission-critical uptime requirements, this role requires hands-on project management experience delivering complex infrastructure projects, not just account and strategy ownership. The person in this seat reports to the Vice President of Sales, North America and acts as the connective tissue between account-level reality, deployment execution, and company-level decisions.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

Segment Blueprint Creation

  • Build and own segment-specific blueprints (robotaxi operators, AV logistics/delivery, AV testing and R&D fleets) that document customer economics, procurement patterns, technical/product requirements, and competitive positioning within each segment
  • Translate blueprint findings into structured inputs for four functions: Product (feature and roadmap priorities), Policy (regulatory and incentive positioning), R&D (technical requirements), and Marketing (positioning and messaging). Own this as a standing feedback loop with defined cadence, not a one-time handoff
  • Maintain and refresh blueprints against market, competitive, and policy shifts; define and track KPIs that indicate segment traction and blueprint accuracy

Strategic Account Management

  • Own relationships for a portfolio of top-tier AV accounts; be the primary point of accountability for account health, growth, and retention
  • Lead negotiation and contract structuring for major, complex, multi-year agreements
  • Drive footprint expansion within key AV accounts, deepening existing relationships to secure large, repeat business as fleets scale
  • Coordinate cross-functional pursuit teams (sales, marketing, legal, finance, product) on major RFPs and large bids, using blueprint data to sharpen proposal strategy

Deployment & Infrastructure Delivery

  • Manage end-to-end project delivery for distributed architecture DCFC deployments, both with and without skid-based configurations, matching site constraints and account requirements
  • Coordinate real estate acquisition through partner relationships, with ChargePoint retaining overall coordination and accountability for site selection, sequencing, and timeline
  • Own installation and commissioning delivery through ChargePoint, ensuring projects meet technical specification and go-live timelines
  • Structure and manage service level agreements built to mission-critical uptime performance standards, whether delivered through partners or directly by ChargePoint, and hold all parties accountable to those standards

Cross-Functional Enablement

  • Act as the primary conduit from account and field intelligence into Product, Policy, R&D, and Marketing — accountable for ensuring blueprint insight measurably changes what gets built, priced, and messaged, not just that it gets reported
  • Provide business case analysis, financial modeling, and ROI assessments to support major pursuits and investment decisions
  • Track performance of segment strategies and deployment delivery against plan; adjust blueprints and account plans as the market evolves

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; MBA a plus. PMP or equivalent project management certification a plus
• 8+ years of combined experience across strategic account management, infrastructure project delivery, and segment or market strategy — ideally within EV charging, energy, or mission-critical technology sectors
• Demonstrated success owning and growing enterprise-level commercial relationships, including negotiating complex, multi-year agreements
• Hands-on project management experience delivering multi-stakeholder infrastructure deployments (real estate, construction, installation) on schedule and to spec; AV or mission-critical uptime environments strongly preferred
• Ability to think strategically and act operationally — converting high-level goals into segment blueprints, account plans, and deployment plans that cross-functional teams can execute directly
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with experience building business cases and ROI assessments to support major pursuits and investment decisions
• Proficiency in market research, competitive analysis, and presenting findings to senior leadership
• In-depth understanding of the e-mobility landscape, DCFC hardware and site design (skid and non-skid distributed architecture), and mission-critical SLA structures highly preferred
• Comfortable with modern productivity and AI tools; able to build original presentations and data-driven deliverables
• Ability to travel frequently, including to active deployment sites, as required by the role

  • Create and improve workflows for Unreal Editor, Unreal Editor for Fortnite, Fortnite and other products

This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. title: Contractor Quality Lead
description:
Role Description

1. Job Title

  • Manager, Contractor Quality Lead (CQL)

2. Role Purpose

  • Acts as the virtual internal Quality representative for Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).

  • Ensures external partners meet Zoetis Quality Standards and comply with GMP and regulatory requirements.
  • Provides Quality oversight for assigned CMOs, with guidance from the Team Leader as needed.
  • Ensures CMOs maintain robust and effective Quality systems.
  • Evaluates Quality-related investigations and supports continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Acts as a liaison between Zoetis and CMOs for:
    • Audits
    • Quality Agreements
    • Deviations
    • Changes
    • Complaints
    • Regulatory commitments
  • Identifies and mitigates Quality and compliance risks.
  • Participates in cross-functional Quality projects.
  • Works collaboratively, seeks guidance when needed, and ensures externally manufactured Zoetis products are safe, effective, and compliant.

3. Supervisor / Reports To

  • Global External Manufacturing Quality Operations Team Leader

4. Core Competencies

Technical Knowledge & Operational Excellence

  • Manages assigned CMOs, with Team Leader support when required.
  • Ensures key Quality activities are monitored and followed up.
  • Demonstrates working knowledge of:
    • Manufacturing processes
    • Validation
    • Test methods
    • Regulatory requirements
  • Seeks guidance where technical knowledge is limited.
  • Tracks, monitors, and analyzes CMO Quality activities using designated tools.
  • Ensures commitments and actions are completed on time.
  • Assesses CMO investigations to confirm:
    • Appropriate root cause identification.
    • Effective CAPA implementation.

Accountable for Results

  • Takes responsibility for actions and results.
  • Plans and organizes work effectively.
  • Aligns priorities with business goals and deadlines.
  • Remains focused and productive under pressure.
  • Sets appropriate priorities and completes commitments on time.
  • Holds CMOs accountable for delivering agreed commitments.

Strategic Thinking & Initiative

  • Demonstrates initiative, independence, and a proactive mindset.
  • Advocates for and implements change aligned with business and Quality objectives.
  • Promotes continuous improvement, simplification, and innovation.
  • Applies lessons learned to improve outcomes.
  • Suggests and supports cost-effectiveness and Quality improvement initiatives at CMOs.

Problem Solving & Decision Making

  • Proactively addresses Quality issues before they escalate.
  • Makes timely, data-driven decisions using experience and sound judgment.
  • Makes decisions even when information is incomplete.
  • Determines appropriate escalation based on risk and impact.
  • Engages and influences appropriate stakeholders.
  • Handles unexpected situations with agility and resilience.
  • Takes appropriate action to mitigate Quality and compliance risks.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Communicates clearly, concisely, and effectively.
  • Tailors communication to the target audience.
  • Builds and maintains collaborative partnerships within Zoetis and with CMOs.
  • Communicates effectively across all organizational levels.
  • Provides executive summaries and proactive updates.
  • Seeks feedback and learns from mistakes.
  • Prioritizes team success over individual accomplishments.

5. Key Responsibilities

Quality Agreements

  • Negotiates terms of the Quality Agreement template.
  • Ensures implementation of the agreement is approved before commercial batch production.
  • Independently evaluates changes to the standard template.
  • Identifies items requiring escalation or additional endorsement.
  • Periodically reviews Quality Agreements to ensure continued compliance.

Change Management

  • Independently assesses product-related change proposals from a Quality perspective.
  • Coordinates regulatory assessments with the Regulatory team.
  • Processes acceptable changes.
  • Manages implementation timelines at the contractor.
  • Escalates significant topics to management of both companies when required.

Deviation Management

  • Independently evaluates the impact of significant CMO deviations.
  • Determines appropriate actions and escalation levels.
  • Engages relevant organizations based on risk and impact.
  • Ensures appropriate follow-up and resolution.

CAPA

  • Provides robust oversight of CMO CAPAs.
  • Tracks CAPA progress.
  • Holds contractors accountable for timely and effective closure.
  • Verifies CAPA effectiveness through data review and follow-up.
  • Escalates delays and systemic issues.
  • Supports compliance and continuous improvement.

Product Disposition & Batch Release

  • Applies the lot disposition process for Zoetis products released to Zoetis by the contractor.
  • Performs annual risk assessments to determine the applicable lot disposition process.

Complaints Management

  • Works with the Pharmacovigilance team on external market complaints.
  • Ensures complaints are investigated thoroughly and within required timelines.
  • Monitors complaint trends.
  • Proactively addresses recurring issues with CMOs.
  • Supports continuous improvement and customer experience.
  • Determines escalation levels for critical complaints and complaint trends.

Materials Management

  • Acts as the Quality Single Point of Contact for Zoetis-tolled materials.
  • Manages Quality-related activities involving suppliers, including:
    • Quality audits
    • Complaints
    • Deviations
    • Regulatory-required information

Annual Product Reviews / Minor Change & Stability Reports

  • Ensures timely receipt of Annual Product Reviews (APRs) from contractors.
  • Thoroughly reviews and endorses APRs.
  • Ensures required corrective and preventive actions are defined and implemented.
  • Ensures stability data and other required information are provided to Regulatory on time.
  • Supports Minor Change and Stability Report (MCSR) submissions.

Auditing

  • Assesses the need for routine CMO audits.
  • Coordinates and facilitates audit activities.
  • Participates in CMO audits.
  • Independently performs audits when qualified under the Zoetis Auditor Certification Program.

Regulatory Activities

  • Maintains a high-level understanding of applicable regulations.
  • Ensures regulatory expectations are met.
  • Works effectively with Regulatory Affairs colleagues across required markets.
  • Independently supports accuracy and compliance of regulatory submissions.

BoH Inspections

  • Monitors upcoming inspections and inspection results.
  • Determines whether CMO CAPA responses are appropriate.
  • Communicates inspection outcomes and relevant actions to stakeholders in a timely manner.

Artwork

  • Reviews draft artwork.
  • Verifies accuracy of critical elements according to applicable procedures.

Digital Systems & Documentation

  • Applies standard work practices.
  • Ensures timely and accurate entry of CMO-related activities into designated digital systems, including:
    • Veeva Vault
    • CMO Tool
    • TrackWise
  • Ensures documentation complies with procedural requirements.

Stability

  • Ensures annual stability commitments are completed on time.
  • Ensures Out-of-Specification (OOS) results are appropriately escalated through the RNR process.
  • Proactively assesses the effectiveness and applicability of the stability program.
  • Supports temperature excursion assessments.
  • Provides stability memos or impact evaluations to support:
    • Product quality
    • Product safety
    • Product efficacy
    • Lot disposition decisions

Other Responsibilities

  • Supports enhancement of the Zoetis Global External Manufacturing Quality System.
  • Revises procedures where required.
  • Leads cross-functional Quality improvement initiatives.
  • Shares best practices.
  • Benchmarks practices across regions.
  • Collaborates with colleagues to optimize systems.
  • Drives continuous improvement.

6. Qualifications, Experience & Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in:
    • Pharmaceutical Science
    • Microbiology
    • Chemistry
    • Equivalent scientific discipline

Experience

  • Significant experience in a regulated industry.
  • Relevant experience in areas such as:
    • Quality Assurance
    • Quality Control
    • Manufacturing
    • Auditing
    • Technical functions, such as Engineering or R&D
    • Regulatory Affairs

Languages

  • Fluent in English.
  • Fluent in the local language.
  • Knowledge of additional regional languages is desirable.

Product & Regulatory Knowledge

  • Knowledge of a broad range of products.
  • Understanding of global regulatory requirements.
  • Experience across a diverse product portfolio is preferred.
  • Animal Health industry experience is ideally preferred.

Travel

  • Willingness to travel up to 20%.

Full time

Legal statement as below

This job advert indicates the general nature and level of work expected. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be asked to perform other duties as required. Additional position specific requirements/responsibilities are contained in approved training curricula.

Visa status re must be eligible to work and live in Ireland as below

Colleague must be legally eligible to live and work in Ireland.

Summary of our Benefits

In addition, to being part the world leading animal health company focused on the needs of those who raise and care for animals we offer a range of benefits such as competitive salary, bonus, 25.5 days holiday per annum plus public holidays, a defined contributory pension plan, private medical insurance for you and your family and empowered flexible working, to name a few. Please note that the benefits outlined are subject to change based on organization decision.

Notice: Zoetis Recruiters will contact candidates via email from an address ending in @zoetis.com and may also initially connect with candidates through LinkedIn, including LinkedIn InMail. Zoetis does not use Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, or other web-based/generic email domains to communicate about job opportunities, interviews, or offers of employment. If you receive a recruitment-related email message claiming to be from Zoetis that does not come from @zoetis.com, please treat it as suspicious. For your security, do not reply, click links, open attachments, share personal or financial information, or send money in response to unexpected or questionable recruitment communications.

title: Overnight Valent Attendant (FT)
description:
LOCATION

The Lodge at Torrey Pines
Step into the timeless craftsman charm of The Lodge at Torrey Pines. Overlooking the world-renowned Torrey Pines Golf Course with views of the Pacific Ocean, the AAA Five Diamond rated resort features 170 rooms and suites, 2 restaurants, a full-service spa, versatile meeting spaces, and unprecedented service.

The Valet Parking Attendant ("Atendiente de Estacionamiento") creates a strong sense of arrival for hotel, restaurant, and banquet guests by welcoming them to the hotel and safely parking their car in the hotel's valet parking areas.
